<?php

namespace App\Helpers;

use HTMLPurifier;
use HTMLPurifier_Config;

class SanitizeHelper
{
    protected static $purifier = null;

    protected static function getPurifier()
    {
        if (self::$purifier === null) {
            $config = HTMLPurifier_Config::createDefault();
            $config->set('HTML.Allowed', 'p,b,i,u,strong,em,a[href],ul,ol,li,br,span,img[src|alt],h1,h2,h3,h4,blockquote,pre,code');
            $config->set('URI.DisableExternalResources', true);
            $config->set('URI.DisableResources', true);
            self::$purifier = new HTMLPurifier($config);
        }
        return self::$purifier;
    }

    public static function sanitize($html)
    {
        if (empty($html)) return '';
        return self::getPurifier()->purify($html);
    }
}<?php

namespace App\Helpers;

use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;

class UploadHelper
{
    public static function isImageMimeValid(UploadedFile $file, $allowedMimes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/jpg'])
    {
        $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
        $mime = finfo_file($finfo, $file->getRealPath());
        finfo_close($finfo);
        return in_array($mime, $allowedMimes);
    }
}<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Galeri;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Helpers\UploadHelper;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use App\Models\LogAktivitas;

class AdminController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Menampilkan daftar admin
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->input('search');
        $statuses = $request->input('status', []); // Array status dari form view

        // Base Query khusus untuk peran admin
        $query = User::where('peran', 'admin');

        // 1. Logika Global Search
        if (!empty($search)) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('email', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('no_handphone', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        // 2. Logika Multi-Filter Checkbox Status
        if (!empty($statuses)) {
            $query->whereIn('status', $statuses);
        }

        // Eksekusi pagination dengan mempertahankan parameter URL query string
        $admins = $query->with('galeri')->latest()->paginate(10)->withQueryString();
        
        // Statistik Card (Murni total data tanpa pengaruh filter pencarian)
        $totalAdmin = User::where('peran', 'admin')->count();
        $activeAdmins = User::where('peran', 'admin')->where('status', 'aktif')->count();
        $inactiveAdmins = User::where('peran', 'admin')->where('status', 'nonaktif')->count();
        
        return view('kelola.admin.indexSuperadmin', compact('admins', 'totalAdmin', 'activeAdmins', 'inactiveAdmins'));
    }

    /**
     * Menampilkan form untuk menambah admin baru
     */
    public function create()
    {
        return view('kelola.admin.create');
    }

    /**
     * Menyimpan data admin baru ke database
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'foto' => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
            'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'email' => 'required|email|unique:users,email',
            'password' => 'required|min:8|confirmed',
            'no_handphone' => 'nullable|string|max:12',
            'status' => 'required|in:aktif,nonaktif',
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto') && !UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($request->file('foto'))) {
            return back()->withErrors(['foto' => 'File bukan gambar yang valid.']);
        }

        $user = User::create([
            'name'         => $request->name,
            'email'        => $request->email,
            'password'     => Hash::make($request->password),
            'peran'        => 'admin',
            'no_handphone' => $request->no_handphone,
            'status'       => $request->status,
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            $path = $request->file('foto')->store('admin', 'public');

            Galeri::create([
                'sumber_id'    => $user->id,
                'path'         => $path,
                'nama_file'    => basename($path), // REMEDIASI: Menggunakan nama acak yang aman dari path Laravel
                'kategori'     => 'admin',
                'is_watermark' => false,
            ]);
        }

        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id'   => auth()->id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Menambahkan admin baru: ' . $request->name,
            'waktu'     => now(),
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-admin')->with('success', 'Admin berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    /**
     * Menampilkan form untuk mengedit data admin
     */
    public function edit(string $id)
    {
        $admin = User::where('peran', 'admin')->findOrFail($id);
        return view('kelola.admin.update', compact('admin'));
    }

    /**
     * Menyimpan pembaruan data admin ke database
     */
    public function update(Request $request, string $id)
    {
        $admin = User::where('peran', 'admin')->findOrFail($id);

        $request->validate([
            'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'email' => 'required|email|unique:users,email,' . $id,
            'no_handphone' => 'required|string|max:20',
            'status' => 'required|in:aktif,nonaktif',
            'password' => 'nullable|min:8|confirmed',
            'foto' => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto') && !UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($request->file('foto'))) {
            return back()->withErrors(['foto' => 'File bukan gambar yang valid.']);
        }

        $data = $request->only(['name', 'email', 'no_handphone', 'status']);
        
        if ($request->filled('password')) {
            $data['password'] = Hash::make($request->password);
        }
        
        $admin->update($data);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            $path = $request->file('foto')->store('admin', 'public');
            $namaFileBaru = basename($path); // REMEDIASI: Menggunakan nama acak yang aman dari path Laravel

            if ($admin->galeri) {
                if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($admin->galeri->path)) {
                    Storage::disk('public')->delete($admin->galeri->path);
                }
                $admin->galeri->update([
                    'path' => $path,
                    'nama_file' => $namaFileBaru,
                ]);
            } else {
                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id'    => $admin->id,
                    'path'         => $path,
                    'nama_file'    => $namaFileBaru,
                    'kategori'     => 'admin',
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
            }
        }

        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id'   => auth()->id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Memperbarui data admin: ' . $admin->name,
            'waktu'     => now(),
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-admin')->with('success', 'Admin berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    /**
     * Menghapus data admin dari database
     */
    public function destroy(string $id)
    {
        $admin = User::where('peran', 'admin')->findOrFail($id);
        
        if ($admin->galeri) {
            if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($admin->galeri->path)) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($admin->galeri->path);
            }
            $admin->galeri->delete();
        }

        $admin->delete();
        
        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id'   => auth()->id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Menghapus admin: ' . $admin->name,
            'waktu'     => now(),
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-admin')->with('success', 'Admin berhasil dihapus.');
    }
}<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\Berita;
use App\Models\Galeri;
use App\Models\LogAktivitas;
use App\Helpers\SanitizeHelper;
use App\Helpers\UploadHelper;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Intervention\Image\ImageManager;
use Intervention\Image\Drivers\Gd\Driver;

class BeritaController extends Controller
{
    // Fungsi untuk menyimpan gambar dengan watermark
    private function simpanDenganWatermark($file)
    {
        $manager = new ImageManager(new Driver());

        // REMEDIASI: Simpan file asli terlebih dahulu dengan nama acak dari Laravel untuk menghindari input mentah klien
        $temporaryPath = $file->store('berita/asli', 'public');
        $filename = basename($temporaryPath);

        // Baca gambar asli
        $image = $manager->read(
            $file->getRealPath()
        );

        // Baca watermark
        $watermark = $manager->read(
            public_path('img/watermark/logo-jeb.png')
        );

        // Resize watermark
        $watermark->scale(
            width: 300
        );

        // Tempel watermark di tengah
        $image->place(
            $watermark,
            'center'
        );

        // Simpan hasil watermark
        $image->save(
            storage_path(
                'app/public/berita/watermark/' .
                $filename
            )
        );

        return 'berita/watermark/' . $filename;
    }

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->input('search');
        $statuses = $request->input('status', []); // Menangkap array status dari filter

        $query = Berita::with(['user', 'galeri']);

        // 1. Global Search (Judul, Isi Berita, Nama Penulis)
        if (!empty($search)) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('judul', 'like', '%' . $search . '%')
                    ->orWhere('isi_berita', 'like', '%' . $search . '%')
                    ->orWhereHas('user', function ($userQuery) use ($search) {
                        $userQuery->where('name', 'like', '%' . $search . '%');
                    });
            });
        }

        // 2. Multi-Filter Status Checkbox
        if (!empty($statuses)) {
            $query->whereIn('status', $statuses);
        }

        $beritas = $query->latest()->paginate(10)->withQueryString();

        // Hitung total statistik riil data murni database
        $totalBerita = Berita::count();
        $ditayangkan = Berita::where('status', 'tayang')->count();
        $tidakDitayangkan = Berita::where('status', 'tidak ditayangkan')->count();

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;

        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return view('kelola.berita.indexSuperadmin', compact('beritas', 'totalBerita', 'ditayangkan', 'tidakDitayangkan'));
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return view('kelola.berita.indexAdmin', compact('beritas', 'totalBerita', 'ditayangkan', 'tidakDitayangkan'));
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Show the form for creating a new resource.
     */
    public function create()
    {
        return view('kelola.berita.create');
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'judul' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'isi' => 'required|string',
            'jenis_berita' => 'required|in:Pengumuman,Prestasi,Kolaborasi,Event,Lainnya',
            'status' => 'required|in:tayang,tidak ditayangkan',
            'foto' => 'required|array',
            'foto.*' => 'image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
        ]);

        $request->merge(['isi' => SanitizeHelper::sanitize($request->isi)]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($file)) {
                    return back()->withErrors(['foto' => 'Salah satu file bukan gambar yang valid.']);
                }
            }
        }

        $berita = Berita::create([
            'judul' => $request->judul,
            'isi_berita' => $request->isi,
            'jenis_berita' => $request->jenis_berita,
            'status' => $request->status,
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                $path = $this->simpanDenganWatermark($file);

                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id' => $berita->id,
                    'path' => $path,
                    'nama_file' => basename($path), // REMEDIASI: Menggunakan nama aman dari path acak internal
                    'kategori' => 'berita',
                    'is_watermark' => true,
                ]);
            }
        }

        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Menambahkan berita baru: ' . $request->judul,
            'waktu' => now(),
        ]);

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;

        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-berita')->with('success', 'Berita berhasil ditambahkan dengan multi-foto.');
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return redirect()->route('admin.kelola-berita')->with('success', 'Berita berhasil ditambahkan dengan multi-foto.');
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified resource.
     */
    public function show(string $id)
    {
        return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-berita');
    }

    /**
     * Show the form for editing the specified resource.
     */
    public function edit(string $id)
    {
        $berita = Berita::with('galeri')->findOrFail($id);
        return view('kelola.berita.update', compact('berita'));
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, string $id)
    {
        $berita = Berita::findOrFail($id);

        $request->validate([
            'judul' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'isi' => 'required|string',
            'jenis_berita' => 'required|in:Pengumuman,Prestasi,Kolaborasi,Event,Lainnya',
            'status' => 'required|in:tayang,tidak ditayangkan',
            'foto' => 'nullable|array',
            'foto.*' => 'image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
            'hapus_foto' => 'nullable|array',
            'hapus_foto.*' => 'exists:galeri,id',
        ]);

        $request->merge(['isi' => SanitizeHelper::sanitize($request->isi)]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($file)) {
                    return back()->withErrors(['foto' => 'Salah satu file bukan gambar yang valid.']);
                }
            }
        }

        $berita->update([
            'judul' => $request->judul,
            'isi_berita' => $request->isi,
            'jenis_berita' => $request->jenis_berita,
            'status' => $request->status,
        ]);

        if ($request->filled('hapus_foto')) {
            foreach ($request->hapus_foto as $fotoId) {
                $fotoLama = Galeri::where('sumber_id', $berita->id)
                    ->where('kategori', 'berita')
                    ->find($fotoId);

                if ($fotoLama) {
                    if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($fotoLama->path)) {
                        Storage::disk('public')->delete($fotoLama->path);
                    }
                    $fotoLama->delete();
                }
            }
        }

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                $path = $this->simpanDenganWatermark($file);

                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id' => $berita->id,
                    'path' => $path,
                    'nama_file' => basename($path), // REMEDIASI: Menggunakan nama aman dari path acak internal
                    'kategori' => 'berita',
                    'is_watermark' => true,
                ]);
            }
        }

        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Memperbarui data berita: ' . $berita->judul,
            'waktu' => now(),
        ]);

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;

        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-berita')->with('success', 'Berita berhasil diperbarui.');
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return redirect()->route('admin.kelola-berita')->with('success', 'Berita berhasil diperbarui.');
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Endpoint upload gambar dari TinyMCE editor.
     * Mengembalikan JSON { location: url } sesuai format TinyMCE.
     */
    public function uploadGambar(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'file' => 'required|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,gif,webp|max:4096',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('file');

        // REMEDIASI: Menambahkan proteksi MIME riil tambahan sebelum memproses berkas TinyMCE
        if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($file)) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Berkas tidak valid.'], 400);
        }

        $path = $this->simpanDenganWatermark($file);

        return response()->json([
            'location' => Storage::disk('public')->url($path),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(string $id)
    {
        $berita = Berita::with('galeri')->findOrFail($id);
        $judulBerita = $berita->judul;

        foreach ($berita->galeri as $foto) {
            if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($foto->path)) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($foto->path);
            }
            $foto->delete();
        }

        $berita->delete();

        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Menghapus berita: ' . $judulBerita,
            'waktu' => now(),
        ]);

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;

        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-berita')->with('success', 'Berita beserta seluruh gambarnya berhasil dihapus.');
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return redirect()->route('admin.kelola-berita')->with('success', 'Berita beserta seluruh gambarnya berhasil dihapus.');
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }
}<?php

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Katalog;
use App\Models\Event;
use App\Models\Berita;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class DashboardAdminController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index()
    {
        // Mendapatkan bulan dan tahun saat ini untuk kalkulasi data bulanan
        $currentMonth = Carbon::now()->month;
        $currentYear = Carbon::now()->year;

        // 1. DATA TOTAL STATISTIK (Tanpa Data Admin)
        $totalKatalog = Katalog::count();
        $activeEvents = Event::where('status', 'belum selesai')->count();
        $totalBerita = Berita::count();

        // 2. HITUNG DATA BARU YANG MASUK BULAN INI (Tanpa Data Admin)
        $newKatalogThisMonth = Katalog::whereMonth('created_at', $currentMonth)
            ->whereYear('created_at', $currentYear)
            ->count();

        $newEventsThisMonth = Event::whereMonth('created_at', $currentMonth)
            ->whereYear('created_at', $currentYear)
            ->count();

        $newBeritaThisMonth = Berita::whereMonth('created_at', $currentMonth)
            ->whereYear('created_at', $currentYear)
            ->count();

        // 3. AMBIL DATA EVENT TERBARU UNTUK DITAMPILKAN DI GRID BAWAH (Substitusi Log Aktivitas)
        $latestEvents = Event::latest()
            ->take(5)
            ->get();

        // 4. AMBIL DATA BERITA TERBARU (Substitusi Tabel Admin)
        $latestBeritas = Berita::with('user')
            ->latest()
            ->take(5)
            ->get();

        // Melempar variabel yang sudah disaring ke dalam View
        return view('kelola.dashboardAdmin', compact(
            'totalKatalog',
            'activeEvents',
            'totalBerita',
            'newKatalogThisMonth',
            'newEventsThisMonth',
            'newBeritaThisMonth',
            'latestEvents',
            'latestBeritas'
        ));
    }

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Event;
use App\Models\Berita;
use App\Models\Katalog;
use App\Models\LogAktivitas;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class DashboardSuperadminController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        // Set lokal bahasa Indonesia untuk tanggal jika diperlukan
        Carbon::setLocale('id');

        // 1. Query untuk 4 Kartu Metrik Utama di Bagian Atas
        $eventMendatangCount = Event::where('status', 'belum selesai')->count();
        $beritaTayangCount = Berita::where('status', 'tayang')->count();
        $totalKatalogCount = Katalog::count();
        $totalLogAktivitas = LogAktivitas::count();

        // 2. Query untuk Tabel Kiri: 5 Event Terdekat yang Belum Selesai
        $upcomingEvents = Event::where('status', 'belum selesai')
            ->orderBy('tanggal', 'asc')
            ->take(5)
            ->get();

        // 3. Query untuk Tabel Kanan: 5 Log Aktivitas Terbaru
        $recentActivities = LogAktivitas::with('user')
            ->latest()
            ->take(5)
            ->get();

        // 4. Melempar semua data ke view dashboard superadmin
        return view('kelola.dashboardSuperadmin', compact(
            'eventMendatangCount',
            'beritaTayangCount',
            'totalKatalogCount',
            'totalLogAktivitas',
            'upcomingEvents',
            'recentActivities'
        ));
    }

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Event;
use App\Models\Galeri;
use App\Models\LogAktivitas;
use App\Helpers\SanitizeHelper;
use App\Helpers\UploadHelper;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

class EventController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->input('search');
        $statuses = $request->input('status', []); // Array status checkbox

        $query = Event::with(['user', 'galeri']);
        
        // 1. Logika Global Search Multi Kolom
        if (!empty($search)) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama', 'like', '%' . $search . '%')
                  ->orWhere('lokasi', 'like', '%' . $search . '%')
                  ->orWhere('kategori', 'like', '%' . $search . '%')
                  ->orWhere('deskripsi', 'like', '%' . $search . '%');
            });
        }

        // 2. Logika Multi-Filter Checkbox Status
        if (!empty($statuses)) {
            $query->whereIn('status', $statuses);
        }
        
        $events = $query->latest()->paginate(10)->withQueryString();
        
        // Menghitung data statistik real data tanpa filter
        $totalEvent = Event::count();
        $selesai = Event::where('status', 'selesai')->count();
        $belumSelesai = Event::where('status', 'belum selesai')->count();

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;

        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return view('kelola.event.indexSuperadmin', compact('events', 'totalEvent', 'selesai', 'belumSelesai'));
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return view('kelola.event.indexAdmin', compact('events', 'totalEvent', 'selesai', 'belumSelesai'));
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Show the form for creating a new resource.
     */
    public function create()
    {
        return view('kelola.event.create');
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'nama'       => 'required|string|max:255',
            'tanggal'    => 'required|date',
            'jam'        => 'required',
            'lokasi'     => 'required|string',
            'kategori'   => 'required|in:Latihan,Pertunjukan,Pelatihan,Lainnya',
            'status'     => 'required|in:selesai,belum selesai',
            'foto'       => 'nullable|array', 
            'foto.*'     => 'image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096', 
        ]);

        $request->merge(['deskripsi' => SanitizeHelper::sanitize($request->deskripsi)]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($file)) {
                    return back()->withErrors(['foto' => 'Salah satu file bukan gambar yang valid.']);
                }
            }
        }

        $event = Event::create([
            'nama'      => $request->nama,
            'deskripsi' => $request->deskripsi ?? '-',
            'tanggal'   => $request->tanggal,
            'jam'       => $request->jam,
            'lokasi'    => $request->lokasi,
            'kategori'  => $request->kategori,
            'status'    => $request->status,
            'user_id'   => Auth::id(),
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                $path = $file->store('event', 'public');
                
                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id'    => $event->id, 
                    'path'         => $path,       
                    'nama_file'    => basename($path), // REMEDIASI: Menggunakan penamaan acak aman dari internal
                    'kategori'     => 'event',
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
            }
        }

        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id'   => Auth::id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Menambahkan event baru: ' . $request->nama,
            'waktu'     => now(),
        ]);

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;

        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-event')->with('success', 'Event berhasil ditambahkan dengan multi-foto.');
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return redirect()->route('admin.kelola-event')->with('success', 'Event berhasil ditambahkan dengan multi-foto.');
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified resource.
     */
    public function show($id)
    {
        return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-event')->with('error', 'Halaman detail tidak tersedia.');
    }

    /**
     * Show the form for editing the specified resource.
     */
    public function edit($id)
    {
        $event = Event::with('galeri')->findOrFail($id);
        return view('kelola.event.update', compact('event'));
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $event = Event::findOrFail($id);

        $request->validate([
            'nama'         => 'required|string|max:255',
            'tanggal'      => 'required|date',
            'jam'          => 'required',
            'lokasi'       => 'required|string',
            'kategori'     => 'required|in:Latihan,Pertunjukan,Pelatihan,Lainnya',
            'status'       => 'required|in:selesai,belum selesai',
            'foto'         => 'nullable|array',
            'foto.*'       => 'image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
            'hapus_foto'   => 'nullable|array', 
            'hapus_foto.*' => 'exists:galeri,id',
        ]);

        $request->merge(['deskripsi' => SanitizeHelper::sanitize($request->deskripsi)]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($file)) {
                    return back()->withErrors(['foto' => 'Salah satu file bukan gambar yang valid.']);
                }
            }
        }

        $event->update([
            'nama'      => $request->nama,
            'deskripsi' => $request->deskripsi ?? $event->deskripsi,
            'tanggal'   => $request->tanggal,
            'jam'       => $request->jam,
            'lokasi'    => $request->lokasi,
            'kategori'  => $request->kategori,
            'status'    => $request->status,
        ]);

        if ($request->filled('hapus_foto')) {
            foreach ($request->hapus_foto as $fotoId) {
                $fotoLama = Galeri::where('sumber_id', $event->id)
                                  ->where('kategori', 'event')
                                  ->find($fotoId);

                if ($fotoLama) {
                    if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($fotoLama->path)) {
                        Storage::disk('public')->delete($fotoLama->path);
                    }
                    $fotoLama->delete();
                }
            }
        }

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                $path = $file->store('event', 'public');
                
                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id'    => $event->id,
                    'path'         => $path,
                    'nama_file'    => basename($path), // REMEDIASI: Menggunakan penamaan acak aman dari internal
                    'kategori'     => 'event',
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
            }
        }

        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id'   => Auth::id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Memperbarui data event: ' . $event->nama,
            'waktu'     => now(),
        ]);

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;

        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-event')->with('success', 'Event berhasil diperbarui.');
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return redirect()->route('admin.kelola-event')->with('success', 'Event berhasil diperbarui.');
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy($id)
    {
        $event = Event::with('galeri')->findOrFail($id);
        $namaEvent = $event->nama;

        foreach ($event->galeri as $foto) {
            if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($foto->path)) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($foto->path);
            }
            $foto->delete();
        }

        $event->delete();

        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id'   => Auth::id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Menghapus event: ' . $namaEvent,
            'waktu'     => now(),
        ]);

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;

        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-event')->with('success', 'Event beserta seluruh gambarnya berhasil dihapus.');
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return redirect()->route('admin.kelola-event')->with('success', 'Event beserta seluruh gambarnya berhasil dihapus.');
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }
}<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Katalog;
use App\Models\Galeri;
use App\Models\LogAktivitas;
use App\Helpers\SanitizeHelper;
use App\Helpers\UploadHelper;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Intervention\Image\ImageManager;
use Intervention\Image\Drivers\Gd\Driver;

class KatalogController extends Controller
{
    private function simpanDenganWatermark($file)
    {
        $manager = new ImageManager(
            new Driver()
        );

        // REMEDIASI: Ambil nama acak aman yang diproduksi dari enkapsulasi internal storage Laravel
        $temporaryPath = $file->store('katalog/asli', 'public');
        $filename = basename($temporaryPath);

        $image = $manager->read(
            $file->getRealPath()
        );

        $watermark = $manager->read(
            public_path(
                'img/watermark/logo-jeb.png'
            )
        );

        // Lebih besar untuk katalog
        $watermark->scale(
            width: 500
        );

        $image->place(
            $watermark,
            'center'
        );

        $image->save(
            storage_path(
                'app/public/katalog/watermark/' .
                $filename
            )
        );

        return 'katalog/watermark/' . $filename;
    }

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        // 1. Ambil data query pencarian & filter dari URL/Request
        $search = $request->input('search');
        $statuses = $request->input('status', []); // Array status
        $categories = $request->input('kategori', []); // Array kategori

        // 2. Buat Base Query dengan Eager Loading
        $query = Katalog::with(['galeri', 'user']);

        // 3. Tambahkan Logika Global Search (Mencari di Nama, Kategori, Deskripsi, dan Stok)
        if (!empty($search)) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama_katalog', 'like', '%' . $search . '%')
                    ->orWhere('kategori', 'like', '%' . $search . '%')
                    ->orWhere('deskripsi', 'like', '%' . $search . '%')
                    ->orWhere('stok', 'like', '%' . $search . '%');
            });
        }

        // 4. Tambahkan Multi-Filter Status (Checkbox)
        if (!empty($statuses)) {
            $query->whereIn('status', $statuses);
        }

        // 5. Tambahkan Multi-Filter Kategori (Checkbox)
        if (!empty($categories)) {
            $query->whereIn('kategori', $categories);
        }

        // 6. Eksekusi Pagination dengan mempertahankan Query Parameters di URL Links
        $katalogs = $query->latest()->paginate(10)->withQueryString();

        // 7. Hitung statistik card (Selalu ambil data total murni tanpa filter pencarian)
        $totalKatalog = Katalog::count();
        $tersedia = Katalog::where('status', 'tersedia')->count();
        $tidakTersedia = Katalog::where('status', 'tidak tersedia')->count();

        return view('kelola.katalog.indexSuperadmin', compact('katalogs', 'totalKatalog', 'tersedia', 'tidakTersedia'));
    }

    /**
     * Show the form for creating a new resource.
     */
    public function create()
    {
        return view('kelola.katalog.create');
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        // 1. VALIDASI MULTI-UPLOAD: Memvalidasi 'foto' sebagai tumpukan array berkas
        $request->validate([
            'nama_katalog' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'kategori' => 'required|string',
            'stok' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'deskripsi' => 'required|string',
            'status' => 'required|in:tersedia,tidak tersedia',
            'foto' => 'required|array',
            'foto.*' => 'image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
        ]);

        $request->merge(['deskripsi' => SanitizeHelper::sanitize($request->deskripsi)]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($file)) {
                    return back()->withErrors(['foto' => 'Salah satu file bukan gambar yang valid.']);
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Simpan informasi teks produk utama ke database
        $katalog = Katalog::create([
            'nama_katalog' => $request->nama_katalog,
            'kategori' => $request->kategori,
            'stok' => $request->stok,
            'deskripsi' => $request->deskripsi,
            'status' => $request->status,
            'user_id' => Auth::id(),
        ]);

        // 3. LOGIKA MULTI-UPLOAD: Menyimpan tumpukan foto fisik produk ke dalam folder storage
        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {

                // File biner asli disimpan ke: public/storage/katalog/
                $path = $this->simpanDenganWatermark($file);

                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id' => $katalog->id,
                    'path' => $path,
                    'nama_file' => basename($path), // REMEDIASI: Menggunakan penamaan acak aman dari internal
                    'kategori' => 'katalog',
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
            }
        }

        // 4. Catat riwayat penambahan barang ke Log Aktivitas
        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id' => Auth::id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Menambahkan katalog produk baru: ' . $request->nama_katalog,
            'waktu' => now(),
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-katalog')->with('success', 'Katalog berhasil ditambahkan dengan multi-foto.');
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified resource.
     */
    public function show($id)
    {
        return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-katalog')->with('error', 'Halaman detail tidak tersedia.');
    }

    /**
     * Show the form for editing the specified resource.
     */
    public function edit($id)
    {
        $katalog = Katalog::with('galeri')->findOrFail($id);
        return view('kelola.katalog.update', compact('katalog'));
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $katalog = Katalog::findOrFail($id);

        $request->validate([
            'nama_katalog' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'kategori' => 'required|string',
            'stok' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'deskripsi' => 'required|string',
            'status' => 'required|in:tersedia,tidak tersedia',
            'foto' => 'nullable|array',
            'foto.*' => 'image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
            'hapus_foto' => 'nullable|array',
            'hapus_foto.*' => 'exists:galeri,id',
        ]);

        $request->merge(['deskripsi' => SanitizeHelper::sanitize($request->deskripsi)]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($file)) {
                    return back()->withErrors(['foto' => 'Salah satu file bukan gambar yang valid.']);
                }
            }
        }
        // 1. Perbarui teks data utama katalog
        $katalog->update([
            'nama_katalog' => $request->nama_katalog,
            'kategori' => $request->kategori,
            'stok' => $request->stok,
            'deskripsi' => $request->deskripsi,
            'status' => $request->status,
        ]);

        // 2. LOGIKA SELEKTIF HAPUS FOTO: Memproses pembuangan gambar lama yang ditandai pengguna
        if ($request->filled('hapus_foto')) {
            foreach ($request->hapus_foto as $fotoId) {
                $fotoLama = Galeri::where('sumber_id', $katalog->id)
                    ->where('kategori', 'katalog')
                    ->find($fotoId);

                if ($fotoLama) {
                    // Singkirkan berkas dari folder public/storage/katalog/
                    if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($fotoLama->path)) {
                        Storage::disk('public')->delete($fotoLama->path);
                    }
                    $fotoLama->delete();
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Tambahkan beberapa foto produk baru jika ada berkas yang masuk
        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                $path = $this->simpanDenganWatermark($file);

                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id' => $katalog->id,
                    'path' => $path,
                    'nama_file' => basename($path), // REMEDIASI: Menggunakan penamaan acak aman dari internal
                    'kategori' => 'katalog',
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
            }
        }

        // 4. Catat riwayat perubahan ke tabel Log Audit Trail
        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id' => Auth::id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Memperbarui data katalog produk: ' . $katalog->nama_katalog,
            'waktu' => now(),
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-katalog')->with('success', 'Katalog berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy($id)
    {
        $katalog = Katalog::with('galeri')->findOrFail($id);
        $namaKatalog = $katalog->nama_katalog;

        // 1. Sapu bersih seluruh berkas fisik gambar di folder lokal komputer sebelum baris record dihapus
        foreach ($katalog->galeri as $foto) {
            if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($foto->path)) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($foto->path);
            }
            $foto->delete();
        }

        // 2. Singkirkan data record dari tabel katalog utama
        $katalog->delete();

        // 3. Rekam jejak penghapusan barang ke Log Aktivitas
        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id' => Auth::id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Menghapus data katalog: ' . $namaKatalog,
            'waktu' => now(),
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-katalog')->with('success', 'Katalog beserta seluruh gambarnya berhasil dihapus.');
    }

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\LogAktivitas;

class LogAktivitasController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->input('search');
        $types = $request->input('tipe', []); // Array penampung filter checkbox popup ("menambahkan", "memperbarui", "menghapus")

        $query = LogAktivitas::with('user');

        // 1. Global Search (Mencari teks aktivitas dan nama user aktor log)
        if (!empty($search)) {
            $query->where(function($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('aktivitas', 'like', '%' . $search . '%')
                  ->orWhereHas('user', function($userQuery) use ($search) {
                      $userQuery->where('name', 'like', '%' . $search . '%');
                  });
            });
        }

        // 2. Multi-Filter Jenis Operasi Data (Looping string keyword)
        if (!empty($types)) {
            $query->where(function($q) use ($types) {
                foreach ($types as $type) {
                    $q->orWhere('aktivitas', 'like', '%' . $type . '%');
                }
            });
        }

        // Jalankan pagination
        $logs = $query->latest()->paginate(15)->withQueryString();

        // FIX SINKRONISASI VARIABEL: Menggunakan nama variabel persis sesuai yang diminta code view Blade Anda
        $totalaktivitas = LogAktivitas::count();
        $tambahaktivitas = LogAktivitas::where('aktivitas', 'like', '%Menambahkan%')->count();
        $editaktivitas   = LogAktivitas::where('aktivitas', 'like', '%Memperbarui%')->count();
        $hapusaktivitas  = LogAktivitas::where('aktivitas', 'like', '%Menghapus%')->count();

        return view('kelola.log_aktivitas.indexSuperadmin', compact(
            'logs', 
            'totalaktivitas', 
            'tambahaktivitas', 
            'editaktivitas', 
            'hapusaktivitas'
        ));
    }

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Galeri;
use App\Models\LogAktivitas;
use App\Helpers\SanitizeHelper;
use App\Helpers\UploadHelper;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

class PengaturanController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index()
    {
        $role = auth()->user()->peran;

        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return view('kelola.pengaturan.indexSuperadmin');
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return view('kelola.pengaturan.indexAdmin');
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Update data profil user yang sedang login (termasuk foto profil)
     */
    public function updateProfil(Request $request)
    {
        $user = auth()->user();

        // Validasi input mengikuti struktur standar AdminController
        $request->validate([
            'foto_profil'  => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096', // Validasi foto baru
            'name'         => 'required|string|max:255',
            'email'        => 'required|email|unique:users,email,' . $user->id,
            'no_handphone' => 'nullable|string|max:20',
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto_profil')) {
            if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($request->file('foto_profil'))) {
                return back()->withErrors(['foto_profil' => 'File bukan gambar yang valid.']);
            }
        }
        // Mengambil input teks utama
        $data = $request->only(['name', 'email', 'no_handphone']);
        
        // Update data utama user pada tabel users
        $user->update($data);

        // Logika pengolahan file foto (Identik dengan AdminController)
        if ($request->hasFile('foto_profil')) {
            // Simpan file fisik foto baru ke disk public di dalam folder 'admin'
            $path = $request->file('foto_profil')->store('admin', 'public');
            $namaFileBaru = basename($path); // REMEDIASI: Menggunakan nama acak aman hasil penyimpanan Laravel

            // Cek apakah user sudah memiliki relasi foto di tabel galeri
            if ($user->galeri) {
                // Hapus berkas foto lama jika filenya ada di storage
                if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($user->galeri->path)) {
                    Storage::disk('public')->delete($user->galeri->path);
                }

                // Perbarui record path data lama di database
                $user->galeri->update([
                    'path'      => $path,
                    'nama_file' => $namaFileBaru,
                ]);
            } else {
                // Jika belum punya foto sama sekali, buat baris record baru di tabel galeri
                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id'    => $user->id,
                    'path'         => $path,
                    'nama_file'    => $namaFileBaru,
                    'kategori'     => 'admin', // Dikunci sebagai admin sesuai sistem galeri Anda
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
            }
        }

        // Mencatat log riwayat aktivitas sistem
        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id'   => auth()->id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Memperbarui profil akun sendiri: ' . $user->name,
            'waktu'     => now(),
        ]);

        return redirect()->route(auth()->user()->peran === 'superadmin' ? 'superadmin.pengaturan' : 'admin.pengaturan')->with('success', 'Profil berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    /**
     * Update password kata sandi user yang sedang login
     */
    public function updatePassword(Request $request)
    {
        $user = auth()->user();
        
        $request->validate([
            'current_password' => [
                'required',
                function ($attribute, $value, $fail) use ($user) {
                    if (!Hash::check($value, $user->password)) {
                        $fail('Password saat ini salah.');
                    }
                }
            ],
            'password' => 'required|min:6|confirmed', // Minimal 6 karakter sesuai instruksi blade Anda
        ]);

        // Mengenkripsi password baru menggunakan Hash driver
        $user->update([
            'password' => Hash::make($request->password)
        ]);

        // Mencatat log riwayat aktivitas sistem
        LogAktivitas::create([
            'user_id'   => auth()->id(),
            'aktivitas' => 'Mengubah kata sandi akun sendiri: ' . $user->name,
            'waktu'     => now(),
        ]);

        return redirect()->route(auth()->user()->peran === 'superadmin' ? 'superadmin.pengaturan' : 'admin.pengaturan')->with('success', 'Password berhasil diubah.');
    }

    /**
     * Method kosong lainnya di bawah ini bawaan resource scaffolding
     */
    public function create() { }
    public function store(Request $request) { }
    public function show(string $id) { }
    public function edit(string $id) { }
    public function destroy(string $id) { }

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\PengaturanSistem;
use App\Models\Galeri;
use App\Helpers\UploadHelper;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

class PengaturanSistemController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        $sistem = PengaturanSistem::with('headers')->first();
        if (!$sistem) {
            $sistem = PengaturanSistem::create([
                'link_maps' => '', 'link_wa' => '', 'link_email' => '', 'link_instagram' => '', 'link_tiktok' => ''
            ]);
        }
        return view('kelola.pengaturan_sistem.index', compact('sistem'));
    }

    public function edit()
    {
        $sistem = PengaturanSistem::with('headers')->first();
        if (!$sistem) {
            $sistem = PengaturanSistem::create([
                'link_maps' => '', 'link_wa' => '', 'link_email' => '', 'link_instagram' => '', 'link_tiktok' => ''
            ]);
        }
        return view('kelola.pengaturan_sistem.edit', compact('sistem'));
    }

    public function update(Request $request)
    {
        $sistem = PengaturanSistem::first();
        if (!$sistem) {
            $sistem = PengaturanSistem::create([
                'link_maps' => '', 'link_wa' => '', 'link_email' => '', 'link_instagram' => '', 'link_tiktok' => ''
            ]);
        }

        $request->validate([
            'link_maps'        => 'nullable|string',
            'link_wa'          => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'link_email'       => 'nullable|email|max:255',
            'link_instagram'   => 'nullable|url|max:255',
            'link_tiktok'      => 'nullable|url|max:255',
            'header_files'     => 'nullable|array',
            'header_files.*'   => 'image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:16384',
            'hapus_header'     => 'nullable|array',
            'hapus_header.*'   => 'exists:galeri,id',
        ]);

        // Hapus Header lama yang ditandai
        if ($request->filled('hapus_header')) {
            foreach ($request->hapus_header as $fotoId) {
                $fotoLama = Galeri::where('sumber_id', $sistem->id)->where('kategori', 'header')->find($fotoId);
                if ($fotoLama) {
                    if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($fotoLama->path)) {
                        Storage::disk('public')->delete($fotoLama->path);
                    }
                    $fotoLama->delete();
                }
            }
        }

        // REMEDIASI: Menambahkan proteksi validasi MIME riil pada file upload header yang sebelumnya terlewat
        if ($request->hasFile('header_files')) {
            foreach ($request->file('header_files') as $file) {
                if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($file)) {
                    return back()->withErrors(['header_files' => 'Salah satu berkas slider header bukan gambar valid.']);
                }
            }
        }

        // Upload Header Baru
        if ($request->hasFile('header_files')) {
            foreach ($request->file('header_files') as $file) {
                $path = $file->store('header', 'public');
                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id'    => $sistem->id,
                    'path'         => $path,
                    'nama_file'    => basename($path), // REMEDIASI: Menggunakan penamaan acak aman internal
                    'kategori'     => 'header',
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
            }
        }

        $sistem->update([
            'link_maps'      => $request->link_maps,
            'link_wa'        => $request->link_wa,
            'link_email'     => $request->link_email,
            'link_instagram' => $request->link_instagram,
            'link_tiktok'    => $request->link_tiktok,
        ]);

        if (class_exists('App\Models\LogAktivitas')) {
            \App\Models\LogAktivitas::create([
                'user_id'   => auth()->id(),
                'aktivitas' => 'Memperbarui konfigurasi media sosial, kontak, dan slider header sistem.',
                'waktu'     => now(),
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('superadmin.pengaturan-sistem.index')->with('success', 'Konfigurasi integrasi sistem berhasil disimpan.');
    }

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\ProfilSanggar;
use App\Models\Personel;
use App\Models\Galeri;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use App\Helpers\SanitizeHelper;
use App\Helpers\UploadHelper;

class ProfilController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index()
    {
        $profil = ProfilSanggar::with(['logo', 'fotoPembina'])->first();

        if (!$profil) {
            $profil = new ProfilSanggar();
        }

        $pengurus = Personel::with('galeri')->where('peran', 'pengurus')->paginate(10);
        $pelatih = Personel::with('galeri')->where('peran', 'pelatih')->paginate(10);

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;
        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return view('kelola.profil.indexSuperadmin', compact('profil', 'pengurus', 'pelatih'));
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return view('kelola.profil.indexAdmin', compact('profil', 'pengurus', 'pelatih'));
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Show the form for editing the specified resource.
     */
    public function edit()
    {
        $profil = ProfilSanggar::with(['logo', 'fotoPembina', 'headers'])->first();

        if (!$profil) {
            $profil = new ProfilSanggar();
        }

        return view('kelola.profil.edit', compact('profil'));
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(Request $request)
    {
        $profil = ProfilSanggar::first();
        if (!$profil) {
            $profil = ProfilSanggar::create([
                'deskripsi' => '', 'visi' => '', 'misi' => '', 'sejarah' => '', 'sambutan_pembina' => ''
            ]);
        }

        $request->validate([
            'deskripsi'        => 'required|string',
            'visi'             => 'required|string',
            'misi'             => 'required|string',
            'sejarah'          => 'required|string',
            'sambutan_pembina' => 'required|string',
            'logo'             => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
            'foto_pembina'     => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
            'header_files'     => 'nullable|array',
            'header_files.*'   => 'image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
        ]);

        // 🔒 Sanitasi HTML pada semua teks yang mungkin mengandung kode berbahaya
        $request->merge([
            'deskripsi'        => SanitizeHelper::sanitize($request->deskripsi),
            'visi'             => SanitizeHelper::sanitize($request->visi),
            'misi'             => SanitizeHelper::sanitize($request->misi),
            'sejarah'          => SanitizeHelper::sanitize($request->sejarah),
            'sambutan_pembina' => SanitizeHelper::sanitize($request->sambutan_pembina),
        ]);

        // 🔒 Validasi MIME riil untuk logo
        if ($request->hasFile('logo') && !UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($request->file('logo'))) {
            return back()->withErrors(['logo' => 'File logo bukan gambar yang valid.']);
        }
        // 🔒 Validasi MIME riil untuk foto_pembina
        if ($request->hasFile('foto_pembina') && !UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($request->file('foto_pembina'))) {
            return back()->withErrors(['foto_pembina' => 'File foto pembina bukan gambar yang valid.']);
        }
        // 🔒 Validasi MIME riil untuk header_files
        if ($request->hasFile('header_files')) {
            foreach ($request->file('header_files') as $file) {
                if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($file)) {
                    return back()->withErrors(['header_files' => 'Salah satu file header bukan gambar yang valid.']);
                }
            }
        }

        // Simpan Logo
        if ($request->hasFile('logo')) {
            $fileLogo = $request->file('logo');
            $pathLogo = $fileLogo->store('galeri', 'public');
            if ($profil->logo_id) {
                $galeriLogoLama = Galeri::find($profil->logo_id);
                if ($galeriLogoLama) {
                    if ($galeriLogoLama->path) {
                        Storage::disk('public')->delete($galeriLogoLama->path);
                    }
                    $galeriLogoLama->update([
                        'path' => $pathLogo,
                        'nama_file' => basename($pathLogo) // REMEDIASI
                    ]);
                }
            } else {
                $galeriLogoBaru = Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id'    => $profil->id,
                    'path'         => $pathLogo,
                    'nama_file'    => basename($pathLogo), // REMEDIASI
                    'kategori'     => 'logo',
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
                $profil->logo_id = $galeriLogoBaru->id;
            }
        }

        // Simpan Foto Pembina
        if ($request->hasFile('foto_pembina')) {
            $filePembina = $request->file('foto_pembina');
            $pathPembina = $filePembina->store('galeri', 'public');
            if ($profil->foto_pembina_id) {
                $galeriPembinaLama = Galeri::find($profil->foto_pembina_id);
                if ($galeriPembinaLama) {
                    if ($galeriPembinaLama->path) {
                        Storage::disk('public')->delete($galeriPembinaLama->path);
                    }
                    $galeriPembinaLama->update([
                        'path' => $pathPembina,
                        'nama_file' => basename($pathPembina) // REMEDIASI
                    ]);
                }
            } else {
                $galeriPembinaBaru = Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id'    => $profil->id,
                    'path'         => $pathPembina,
                    'nama_file'    => basename($pathPembina), // REMEDIASI
                    'kategori'     => 'pembina',
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
                $profil->foto_pembina_id = $galeriPembinaBaru->id;
            }
        }

        // ✅ TAMBAHAN: Simpan Header Files (Multi-Upload)
        if ($request->hasFile('header_files')) {
            foreach ($request->file('header_files') as $file) {
                $path = $file->store('header', 'public');
                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id'    => $profil->id,
                    'path'         => $path,
                    'nama_file'    => basename($path), // REMEDIASI
                    'kategori'     => 'header',
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
            }
        }

        // Update data teks yang sudah disanitasi
        $profil->update([
            'deskripsi'        => $request->deskripsi,
            'visi'             => $request->visi,
            'misi'             => $request->misi,
            'sejarah'          => $request->sejarah,
            'sambutan_pembina' => $request->sambutan_pembina,
        ]);

        if (class_exists('App\Models\LogAktivitas')) {
            \App\Models\LogAktivitas::create([
                'user_id'   => auth()->id(),
                'aktivitas' => 'Memperbarui profil sanggar',
                'waktu'     => now(),
            ]);
        }

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;
        $routeName = ($role === 'superadmin') ? 'superadmin.kelola-profil' : 'admin.kelola-profil';
        return redirect()->route($routeName)->with('success', 'Profil sanggar berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function storePengurus(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'nama'      => 'required|string|max:255',
            'jabatan'   => 'required|string',
            'instagram' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'no_hp'     => 'nullable|string|max:20',
            'status'    => 'required|in:aktif,nonaktif',
            'foto'      => 'required|array',
            'foto.*'    => 'image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
        ]);

        // Validasi MIME riil
        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($file)) {
                    return back()->withErrors(['foto' => 'Salah satu file bukan gambar yang valid.']);
                }
            }
        }

        $personel = Personel::create([
            'nama'         => $request->nama,
            'jabatan'      => $request->jabatan,
            'instagram'    => $request->instagram,
            'no_handphone' => $request->no_hp,
            'status'       => $request->status,
            'peran'        => 'pengurus',
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                $path = $file->store('personel', 'public');
                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id'    => $personel->id,
                    'path'         => $path,
                    'nama_file'    => basename($path), // REMEDIASI
                    'kategori'     => 'profil',
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
            }
        }

        if (class_exists('App\Models\LogAktivitas')) {
            \App\Models\LogAktivitas::create([
                'user_id'   => auth()->id(),
                'aktivitas' => 'Menambahkan pengurus baru: ' . $request->nama,
                'waktu'     => now(),
            ]);
        }

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;
        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-profil')->with('success', 'Data pengurus baru beserta galeri foto berhasil disimpan.');
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return redirect()->route('admin.kelola-profil')->with('success', 'Data pengurus baru beserta galeri foto berhasil disimpan.');
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }

    public function editPengurus(string $id)

        return view('kelola.profil.edit_pengurus', compact('pengurus'));
    }

    public function updatePengurus(Request $request, string $id)
    {
        $pengurus = Personel::findOrFail($id);

        $request->validate([
            'nama'         => 'required|string|max:255',
            'jabatan'      => 'required|string',
            'instagram'    => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'no_hp'        => 'nullable|string|max:20',
            'status'       => 'required|in:aktif,nonaktif',
            'foto'         => 'nullable|array',
            'foto.*'       => 'image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:4096',
            'hapus_foto'   => 'nullable|array',
            'hapus_foto.*' => 'exists:galeri,id',
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                if (!UploadHelper::isImageMimeValid($file)) {
                    return back()->withErrors(['foto' => 'Salah satu file bukan gambar yang valid.']);
                }
            }
        }

        $pengurus->update([
            'nama'         => $request->nama,
            'jabatan'      => $request->jabatan,
            'instagram'    => $request->instagram,
            'no_handphone' => $request->no_hp,
            'status'       => $request->status,
        ]);

        // Hapus foto lama yang ditandai
        if ($request->filled('hapus_foto')) {
            foreach ($request->hapus_foto as $fotoId) {
                $fotoLama = Galeri::where('sumber_id', $pengurus->id)
                                  ->where('kategori', 'profil')
                                  ->find($fotoId);
                if ($fotoLama) {
                    if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($fotoLama->path)) {
                        Storage::disk('public')->delete($fotoLama->path);
                    }
                    $fotoLama->delete();
                }
            }
        }

        // Upload foto baru
        if ($request->hasFile('foto')) {
            foreach ($request->file('foto') as $file) {
                $path = $file->store('personel', 'public');
                Galeri::create([
                    'sumber_id'    => $pengurus->id,
                    'path'         => $path,
                    'nama_file'    => basename($path), // REMEDIASI
                    'kategori'     => 'profil',
                    'is_watermark' => false,
                ]);
            }
        }

        if (class_exists('App\Models\LogAktivitas')) {
            \App\Models\LogAktivitas::create([
                'user_id'   => auth()->id(),
                'aktivitas' => 'Memperbarui data pengurus: ' . $pengurus->nama,
                'waktu'     => now(),
            ]);
        }

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;
        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-profil')->with('success', 'Data profil pengurus berhasil diperbarui.');
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return redirect()->route('admin.kelola-profil')->with('success', 'Data profil pengurus berhasil diperbarui.');
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }

    public function hapusPengurus(string $id)
    {
        $pengurus = Personel::findOrFail($id);
        foreach ($pengurus->galeri as $foto) {
            if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($foto->path)) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($foto->path);
            }
            $foto->delete();
        }
        $pengurus->delete();

        $role = auth()->user()->peran;
        if ($role === 'superadmin') {
            return redirect()->route('superadmin.kelola-profil')->with('success', 'Data pengurus berhasil dihapus.');
        } elseif ($role === 'admin') {
            return redirect()->route('admin.kelola-profil')->with('success', 'Data pengurus berhasil dihapus.');
        } else {
            abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses.');
        }
    }

}<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Requests\ProfileUpdateRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Redirect;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class ProfileController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Menampilkan halaman form edit profil pengguna (Auth)
     * Mengarah ke file: resources/views/profile/edit.blade.php
     */
    public function edit(Request $request): View
    {
        return view('profile.edit', [
            'user' => $request->user(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Memperbarui informasi profil pengguna
     */
    public function update(ProfileUpdateRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->user()->fill($request->validated());

        if ($request->user()->isDirty('email')) {
            $request->user()->email_verified_at = null;
        }

        $request->user()->save();

        return Redirect::route('profile.edit')->with('status', 'profile-updated');
    }

    /**
     * Menghapus akun pengguna
     */
    public function destroy(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validateWithBag('userDeletion', [
            'password' => ['required', 'current_password'],
        ]);

        $user = $request->user();

        Auth::logout();

        $user->delete();

        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return Redirect::to('/');
    }

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Berita;
use App\Models\Event;
use App\Models\Katalog;
use App\Models\Galeri;
use App\Models\ProfilSanggar;
use App\Models\Personel;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class UmumController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        // 1. Ambil data utama sanggar
        $profil = \App\Models\ProfilSanggar::first(); // Sesuaikan nama namespace model kamu
        
        // 2. Ambil data katalog secara acak
        $katalogs = \App\Models\Katalog::inRandomOrder()->take(3)->get();
        
        // 3. Logika pengambilan Berita
        $beritaUtama = \App\Models\Berita::where('status', 'tayang')->latest()->first();
        $beritaTerbaru = \App\Models\Berita::where('status', 'tayang')
                            ->where('id', '!=', $beritaUtama?->id)
                            ->latest()
                            ->take(3)
                            ->get();
        
        // 4. Ambil data Galeri secara acak
        $kategoriPengecualian = ['pembina', 'admin', 'logo', 'header', 'profil'];

        $galeri = \App\Models\Galeri::whereNotIn(\DB::raw('LOWER(kategori)'), $kategoriPengecualian)
            ->where(function($query) use ($kategoriPengecualian) {
                foreach ($kategoriPengecualian as $keyword) {
                    $query->where(\DB::raw('LOWER(path)'), 'not like', '%' . $keyword . '%');
                }
            })
            ->inRandomOrder()
            ->take(6)
            ->get();
            
        // 5. Ambil data Event secara acak
        $events = \App\Models\Event::inRandomOrder()->take(3)->get();
        

        // Data pembantu untuk widget kalender bawaan (jika diperlukan)
        $blankDays = 5; 
        $daysInMonth = 31;
        $eventDays = \App\Models\Event::pluck('tanggal')->map(function($tgl) {
            return (int) \Carbon\Carbon::parse($tgl)->format('d');
        })->toArray();

        // Kirim SEMUA variabel yang dibutuhkan view di dalam compact()
        return view('umum.landing_page', compact(
            'profil', 
            'katalogs', 
            'beritaUtama', 
            'beritaTerbaru', 
            'galeri', 
            'events', 
            'blankDays',
            'daysInMonth',
            'eventDays'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Halaman Daftar Berita Publik (Dengan Fitur Searching & Multi-Filter Kategori)
     */
    public function berita(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->input('search');
        $categories = $request->input('kategori', []); // Menangkap array checkbox kategori dari form blade

        // Ambil data profil beserta tumpukan gambar header untuk banner atas
        $profil = ProfilSanggar::with('headers')->first();

        // Base query: Hanya menampilkan berita yang sudah disetujui untuk 'tayang'
        $query = Berita::where('status', 'tayang')->with(['user', 'galeri']);

        // 1. Penerapan Fitur Global Searching (Judul atau Isi Teks Berita)
        if (!empty($search)) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('judul', 'like', '%' . $search . '%')
                  ->orWhere('isi_berita', 'like', '%' . $search . '%');
            });
        }

        // 2. Penerapan Fitur Multi-Filtering Kategori Konten Berita
        if (!empty($categories)) {
            $query->whereIn('jenis_berita', $categories);
        }

        // Ambil data terbaru dengan sistem pagination (9 data per halaman agar grid 3x3 simetris)
        $beritas = $query->latest()->paginate(12)->withQueryString();

        return view('umum.berita.index', compact('beritas', 'profil'));
    }

        $beritaLainnya = Berita::with(['galeri', 'user'])

    /**
     * Halaman Daftar Event Publik
     */
    public function event(Request $request)
    {
        $search = $request->input('search');
        $statuses = $request->input('status', []);

        $profil = ProfilSanggar::with('headers')->first();
        $query = Event::query();

        // Filter Pencarian Teks
        if (!empty($search)) {
            $query->where(function($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('nama', 'like', '%' . $search . '%')
                ->orWhere('lokasi', 'like', '%' . $search . '%');
            });
        }

        // Filter Status Kegiatan
        if (!empty($statuses)) {
            $query->whereIn('status', $statuses);
        }

        // Ambil SEMUA data tanpa paginasi khusus untuk suplai KALENDER penuh
        $allEvents = $query->clone()->orderBy('tanggal', 'asc')->get();

        // Tetap menggunakan paginasi 3 data untuk list kartu awal di sebelah kanan
        $events = $query->orderBy('tanggal', 'asc')->paginate(3)->withQueryString();

        return view('umum.event.index', [
            'events' => $events,
            'allEvents' => $allEvents, 
            'profil' => $profil,
        ]);
    }

            ->inRandomOrder()
            ->take(4)
            // Pas dengan layout grid baru kita
            ->get();

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Auth\LoginRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class AuthenticatedSessionController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the login view.
     */
    public function create(): View
    {
        return view('auth.login');
    }

    /**
     * Handle an incoming authentication request.
     */
    public function store(LoginRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        // Validasi wajib centang captcha
        $request->validate([
            'g-recaptcha-response' => ['required'],
        ], [
            'g-recaptcha-response.required' => 'Silakan centang reCAPTCHA terlebih dahulu.',
        ]);

        // Verifikasi ke server Google
        $response = Http::asForm()->post(
            'https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api/siteverify',
            [
                'secret' => env('RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY'),
                'response' => $request->input('g-recaptcha-response'),
            ]
        );

        $hasilCaptcha = $response->json();

        if (!($hasilCaptcha['success'] ?? false)) {
            return back()
                ->withErrors([
                    'g-recaptcha-response' => 'Verifikasi reCAPTCHA gagal.'
                ])
                ->withInput();
        }

        $request->authenticate();

        $request->session()->regenerate();

        // Ambil data user yang login
        $user = Auth::user();

        if ($user->status !== 'aktif') {

            Auth::logout();

            $request->session()->invalidate();
            $request->session()->regenerateToken();

            return back()->withErrors([
                'email' => 'Akun Anda telah dinonaktifkan. Hubungi Super Admin.'
            ]);
        }

        // SINKRONISASI COATING ROLE (Menggunakan route() murni untuk mematikan intended bypass)
        if ($user->peran === 'superadmin') {
            return redirect()->route('superadmin.dashboard');
        } elseif ($user->peran === 'admin') {
            return redirect()->route('admin.dashboard');
        }

        // Jika peran tidak dikenali, logout paksa agar tidak menggantung di sistem
        Auth::guard('web')->logout();
        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return redirect()->route('login')->with('error', 'Peran anda tidak diketahui, mohon hubungi pihak terkait.');
    }

    /**
     * Destroy an authenticated session.
     */
    public function destroy(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        Auth::guard('web')->logout();

        $request->session()->invalidate();

        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return redirect('/');
    }
}<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class ConfirmablePasswordController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Show the confirm password view.
     */
    public function show(): View
    {
        return view('auth.confirm-password');
    }

    /**
     * Confirm the user's password.
     */
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! Auth::guard('web')->validate([
            'email' => $request->user()->email,
            'password' => $request->password,
        ])) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'password' => __('auth.password'),
            ]);
        }

        $request->session()->put('auth.password_confirmed_at', time());

        return redirect()->intended(route('dashboard', absolute: false));
    }
}

    }
