<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Events\PasswordReset;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Password;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class NewPasswordController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the password reset view.
     */
    public function create(Request $request): View
    {
        return view('auth.reset-password', ['request' => $request]);
    }

    /**
     * Handle an incoming new password request.
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'token' => ['required'],
            'email' => ['required', 'email'],
            'password' => ['required', 'confirmed', Rules\Password::defaults()],
        ]);

        // Here we will attempt to reset the user's password. If it is successful we
        // will update the password on an actual user model and persist it to the
        // database. Otherwise we will parse the error and return the response.
        $status = Password::reset(
            $request->only('email', 'password', 'password_confirmation', 'token'),
            function (User $user) use ($request) {
                $user->forceFill([
                    'password' => Hash::make($request->password),
                    'remember_token' => Str::random(60),
                ])->save();

                event(new PasswordReset($user));
            }
        );

        // If the password was successfully reset, we will redirect the user back to
        // the application's home authenticated view. If there is an error we can
        // redirect them back to where they came from with their error message.
        return $status == Password::PASSWORD_RESET
                    ? redirect()->route('login')->with('status', __($status))
                    : back()->withInput($request->only('email'))
                        ->withErrors(['email' => __($status)]);
    }
}
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Otp;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class OtpController extends Controller
{
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    // STEP 1: Tampilkan form input email (lupa password)
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    public function showForgotForm()
    {
        return view('auth.forgot_password');
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    // STEP 2: Proses email → buat & kirim OTP
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    public function sendOtp(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'email' => ['required', 'email', 'exists:users,email'],
        ], [
            'email.exists' => 'Email tidak ditemukan dalam sistem kami.',
        ]);

        $user = User::where('email', $request->email)->first();

        // Hapus OTP lama milik user ini
        Otp::where('user_id', $user->id)->delete();

        // Buat kode OTP 6 digit
        $kode = str_pad(random_int(0, 999999), 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);

        // Simpan ke database
        Otp::create([
            'user_id'    => $user->id,
            'kode'       => $kode,
            'expires_at' => Carbon::now()->addMinutes(10),
        ]);

        // Kirim email
        Mail::send('emails.otp', ['kode' => $kode, 'user' => $user], function ($message) use ($user) {
            $message->to($user->email)
                    ->subject('Kode Verifikasi Reset Password – Sanggar Tari JEB');
        });

        // Simpan email di session untuk digunakan di step berikutnya
        session(['otp_email' => $user->email]);

        return redirect()->route('otp.verify.form')
                         ->with('success', 'Kode OTP telah dikirim ke email Anda.');
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    // STEP 3: Tampilkan form verifikasi OTP
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    public function showVerifyForm()
    {
        if (!session('otp_email')) {
            return redirect()->route('otp.forgot.form')
                             ->withErrors(['email' => 'Sesi tidak valid, silakan ulangi.']);
        }

        return view('auth.verifikasi_otp');
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    // STEP 4: Verifikasi kode OTP yang dimasukkan
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    public function verifyOtp(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'otp' => ['required', 'string', 'size:6'],
        ]);

        $email = session('otp_email');
        if (!$email) {
            return redirect()->route('otp.forgot.form')
                             ->withErrors(['otp' => 'Sesi tidak valid, silakan ulangi.']);
        }

        $user = User::where('email', $email)->first();
        if (!$user) {
            return redirect()->route('otp.forgot.form')
                             ->withErrors(['otp' => 'User tidak ditemukan.']);
        }

        $otp = Otp::where('user_id', $user->id)
                  ->where('kode', $request->otp)
                  ->first();

        if (!$otp) {
            return back()->withErrors(['otp' => 'Kode OTP tidak valid.']);
        }

        if (Carbon::now()->greaterThan($otp->expires_at)) {
            $otp->delete();
            return back()->withErrors(['otp' => 'Kode OTP sudah kadaluarsa. Silakan kirim ulang.']);
        }

        // OTP valid → tandai di session, hapus OTP dari DB
        session(['otp_verified' => true]);
        $otp->delete();

        return redirect()->route('otp.reset.form');
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    // STEP 5: Tampilkan form reset password baru
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    public function showResetForm()
    {
        if (!session('otp_email') || !session('otp_verified')) {
            return redirect()->route('otp.forgot.form')
                             ->withErrors(['email' => 'Akses tidak sah. Silakan ulangi proses.']);
        }

        return view('auth.reset_password');
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    // STEP 6: Simpan password baru
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    public function resetPassword(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'password'              => ['required', 'string', 'min:8', 'confirmed'],
            'password_confirmation' => ['required'],
        ], [
            'password.min'        => 'Password minimal 8 karakter.',
            'password.confirmed'  => 'Konfirmasi password tidak cocok.',
        ]);

        $email = session('otp_email');
        if (!$email || !session('otp_verified')) {
            return redirect()->route('otp.forgot.form')
                             ->withErrors(['email' => 'Sesi tidak valid, silakan ulangi.']);
        }

        $user = User::where('email', $email)->first();
        if (!$user) {
            return redirect()->route('otp.forgot.form')
                             ->withErrors(['email' => 'User tidak ditemukan.']);
        }

        $user->update(['password' => Hash::make($request->password)]);

        // Bersihkan session OTP
        session()->forget(['otp_email', 'otp_verified']);

        return redirect()->route('login')
                         ->with('status', 'Password berhasil diubah! Silakan login.');
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    // BONUS: Kirim ulang OTP
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    public function resendOtp()
    {
        $email = session('otp_email');
        if (!$email) {
            return redirect()->route('otp.forgot.form')
                             ->withErrors(['email' => 'Sesi tidak valid.']);
        }

        $user = User::where('email', $email)->first();
        if (!$user) {
            return redirect()->route('otp.forgot.form');
        }

        // Cek rate limit: jangan kirim ulang kalau OTP lama belum 1 menit
        $existingOtp = Otp::where('user_id', $user->id)->first();
        if ($existingOtp && Carbon::now()->lessThan($existingOtp->expires_at->subMinutes(9))) {
            return back()->withErrors(['otp' => 'Harap tunggu 1 menit sebelum meminta kode baru.']);
        }

        Otp::where('user_id', $user->id)->delete();

        $kode = str_pad(random_int(0, 999999), 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        Otp::create([
            'user_id'    => $user->id,
            'kode'       => $kode,
            'expires_at' => Carbon::now()->addMinutes(10),
        ]);

        Mail::send('emails.otp', ['kode' => $kode, 'user' => $user], function ($message) use ($user) {
            $message->to($user->email)
                    ->subject('Kode Verifikasi Reset Password – Sanggar Tari JEB');
        });

        return back()->with('success', 'Kode OTP baru telah dikirim ke email Anda.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;

class PasswordController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Update the user's password.
     */
    public function update(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $validated = $request->validateWithBag('updatePassword', [
            'current_password' => ['required', 'current_password'],
            'password' => ['required', Password::defaults(), 'confirmed'],
        ]);

        $request->user()->update([
            'password' => Hash::make($validated['password']),
        ]);

        return back()->with('status', 'password-updated');
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Password;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class PasswordResetLinkController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the password reset link request view.
     */
    public function create(): View
    {
        return view('auth.forgot-password');
    }

    /**
     * Handle an incoming password reset link request.
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'email' => ['required', 'email'],
        ]);

        // We will send the password reset link to this user. Once we have attempted
        // to send the link, we will examine the response then see the message we
        // need to show to the user. Finally, we'll send out a proper response.
        $status = Password::sendResetLink(
            $request->only('email')
        );

        return $status == Password::RESET_LINK_SENT
                    ? back()->with('status', __($status))
                    : back()->withInput($request->only('email'))
                        ->withErrors(['email' => __($status)]);
    }
}
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Events\Registered;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class RegisteredUserController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the registration view.
     */
    public function create(): View
    {
        return view('auth.register');
    }

    /**
     * Handle an incoming registration request.
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
{
    $request->validate([
        'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
        'email' => ['required', 'string', 'lowercase', 'email', 'max:255', 'unique:'.User::class],
        'password' => ['required', 'confirmed', Rules\Password::defaults()],
        // Tambahkan validasi untuk field wajib lainnya
        'peran' => ['required', 'string'],
        'no_handphone' => ['required', 'string', 'max:15'],
        'g-recaptcha-response' => ['required'], 
    ]);

    $user = User::create([
        'name' => $request->name,
        'email' => $request->email,
        'password' => Hash::make($request->password),
        'peran' => $request->peran, 
        'no_handphone' => $request->no_handphone, 
        'status' => 'aktif', 
    ]);

    event(new Registered($user));

    Auth::login($user);

    
    return redirect('/admin/dashboard'); 
}
}<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Auth\Events\Verified;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\EmailVerificationRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;

class VerifyEmailController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Mark the authenticated user's email address as verified.
     */
    public function __invoke(EmailVerificationRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        if ($request->user()->hasVerifiedEmail()) {
            return redirect()->intended(route('dashboard', absolute: false).'?verified=1');
        }

        if ($request->user()->markEmailAsVerified()) {
            event(new Verified($request->user()));
        }

        return redirect()->intended(route('dashboard', absolute: false).'?verified=1');
    }
}
<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class AdminAuth
{
    /**
     * Handle an incoming request.
     *
     * @param  \Closure(\Illuminate\Http\Request): (\Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response)  $next
     */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $user = auth()->user();

        if (!$user || $user->peran !== 'admin') {
            return response()->view('error.akses', ['peran' => 'Admin'], 403);
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Auth;

use Illuminate\Auth\Events\Lockout;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class LoginRequest extends FormRequest
{
    /**
     * Determine if the user is authorized to make this request.
     */
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Get the validation rules that apply to the request.
     *
     * @return array<string, ValidationRule|array<mixed>|string>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'email' => ['required', 'string', 'email'],
            'password' => ['required', 'string'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Attempt to authenticate the request's credentials.
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function authenticate(): void
    {
        $this->ensureIsNotRateLimited();

        if (! Auth::attempt($this->only('email', 'password'), $this->boolean('remember'))) {
            RateLimiter::hit($this->throttleKey());

            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'email' => trans('auth.failed'),
            ]);
        }

        RateLimiter::clear($this->throttleKey());
    }

    /**
     * Ensure the login request is not rate limited.
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function ensureIsNotRateLimited(): void
    {
        if (! RateLimiter::tooManyAttempts($this->throttleKey(), 5)) {
            return;
        }

        event(new Lockout($this));

        $seconds = RateLimiter::availableIn($this->throttleKey());

        throw ValidationException::withMessages([
            'email' => trans('auth.throttle', [
                'seconds' => $seconds,
                'minutes' => ceil($seconds / 60),
            ]),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Get the rate limiting throttle key for the request.
     */
    public function throttleKey(): string
    {
        return Str::transliterate(Str::lower($this->string('email')).'|'.$this->ip());
    }
}

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;

class User extends Authenticatable
{
    use HasFactory, Notifiable;

    // Mass Assignment Protection: Mencegah perubahan kolom sensitif secara ilegal
    protected $fillable = [
        'name',
        'email',
        'password',
        'peran',
        'no_handphone',
        'status',
    ];

    // Data Privacy: Menyembunyikan password saat data dikonversi ke Array/JSON
    protected $hidden = [
        'password',
        'remember_token',
    ];

    // Security Casting: Otomatis menghash password dan mengonversi tipe data waktu
    protected $casts = [
        'email_verified_at' => 'datetime',
        'password' => 'hashed',
    ];

    /** * Hubungan (Relationships):
     * Seorang User (Admin) bisa membuat banyak data konten.
     */

    public function galeri()
    {
         return $this->hasOne(Galeri::class, 'sumber_id', 'id')->where('kategori', 'admin');
    }

    public function berita()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Berita::class, 'user_id', 'id');
    }

    public function event()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Event::class, 'user_id', 'id');
    }

    public function katalog()
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Katalog::class, 'user_id', 'id');
    }
}<?php

use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware;

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withRouting(
        web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
        commands: __DIR__.'/../routes/console.php',
        health: '/up',
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware): void {
        // Daftarkan alias middleware SuperAdminAuth
        $middleware->alias([
            'superadmin.auth' => \App\Http\Middleware\SuperAdminAuth::class,
            'admin.auth'      => \App\Http\Middleware\AdminAuth::class,
        ]);
    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions): void {
        // 404 → tampilkan popup halaman tidak ditemukan
        $exceptions->render(function (\Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\NotFoundHttpException $e, $request) {
            // Deteksi apakah request berasal dari area superadmin
            if ($request->is('superadmin/*') || $request->is('superadmin')) {
                return response()->view('error.path', [], 404);
            }
            // Untuk semua halaman lain (termasuk umum)
            return response()->view('error.path', [], 404);
        });

        // 500 / ValidationException dari area superadmin → popup server error
        $exceptions->render(function (\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException $e, $request) {
            if ($request->is('superadmin/*') || $request->is('superadmin')) {
                // Kembalikan ke halaman sebelumnya dengan error validasi
                // (popup server ditampilkan via session flash di blade)
                return back()->withErrors($e->errors())->withInput()->with('validation_error', true);
            }
        });

        // $exceptions->render(function (\Exception $e, $request) {
        //     if ($request->is('superadmin/*') || $request->is('superadmin')) {
        //         return response()->view('error.server', ['message' => $e->getMessage()], 500);
        //     }
        // });
    })->create();

<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @extends Factory<User>
 */
class UserFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * The current password being used by the factory.
     */
    protected static ?string $password;

    /**
     * Define the model's default state.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => fake()->name(),
            'email' => fake()->unique()->safeEmail(),
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'password' => static::$password ??= Hash::make('password'),
            'remember_token' => Str::random(10),
            'peran' => 'user',
            'status' => 'aktif',
            'no_handphone' => fake()->phoneNumber(),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Indicate that the model's email address should be unverified.
     */
    public function unverified(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'email_verified_at' => null,
        ]);
    }
}

<script>
    function togglePw() {
        const inp  = document.getElementById('password');
        const icon = document.getElementById('eye-icon');
        const show = inp.type === 'password';
        inp.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
        icon.innerHTML = show
            ? '<path d="M17.94 17.94A10.07 10.07 0 0 1 12 20c-7 0-11-8-11-8a18.45 18.45 0 0 1 5.06-5.94M9.9 4.24A9.12 9.12 0 0 1 12 4c7 0 11 8 11 8a18.5 18.5 0 0 1-2.16 3.19m-6.72-1.07a3 3 0 1 1-4.24-4.24"/><line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"/>'
            : '<path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>';
    }
</script>

<script>
    // Toggle show/hide password
    function togglePw(id, el) {
        const input = document.getElementById(id);
        input.type = input.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
    }

    // Password strength meter
    const pwInput = document.getElementById('password');
    const fill = document.getElementById('strength-fill');

    pwInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
        const val = pwInput.value;
        let score = 0;
        if (val.length >= 8) score++;
        if (/[A-Z]/.test(val)) score++;
        if (/[0-9]/.test(val)) score++;
        if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(val)) score++;

        const colors = ['#e53e3e','#ed8936','#ecc94b','#48bb78'];
        const widths = ['25%','50%','75%','100%'];
        fill.style.width  = score > 0 ? widths[score - 1] : '0';
        fill.style.background = score > 0 ? colors[score - 1] : 'transparent';
    });
</script>

<script>
    // ── Auto-tab & navigasi OTP ──
    const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('.otp-input');
    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('otp-hidden');
    const form = document.getElementById('otp-form');

    inputs.forEach((input, index) => {
        input.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            // Pastikan hanya angka
            input.value = input.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
            if (input.value) {
                input.classList.add('filled');
                if (index < inputs.length - 1) inputs[index + 1].focus();
            } else {
                input.classList.remove('filled');
            }
        });

        input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !input.value && index > 0) {
                inputs[index - 1].focus();
                inputs[index - 1].classList.remove('filled');
            }
        });

        input.addEventListener('paste', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const pasteData = e.clipboardData.getData('text').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 6);
            pasteData.split('').forEach((char, i) => {
                if (inputs[i]) {
                    inputs[i].value = char;
                    inputs[i].classList.add('filled');
                }
            });
            if (inputs[pasteData.length - 1]) inputs[pasteData.length - 1].focus();
        });
    });

    // Gabungkan nilai saat submit
    form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
        const otp = Array.from(inputs).map(i => i.value).join('');
        if (otp.length < 6) {
            e.preventDefault();
            alert('Masukkan semua 6 digit kode OTP.');
            return;
        }
        hiddenInput.value = otp;
    });

    // ── Countdown Timer 10 menit ──
    let seconds = 600;
    const countdownEl = document.getElementById('countdown');
    const countdownWrap = document.getElementById('countdown-wrap');
    const resendWrap = document.getElementById('resend-wrap');

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
        seconds--;
        if (seconds <= 0) {
            clearInterval(timer);
            countdownWrap.style.display = 'none';
            resendWrap.style.display = 'inline';
        } else {
            const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
            const s = (seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
            countdownEl.textContent = `${m}:${s}`;
        }
    }, 1000);

    // Fokus ke kotak pertama saat halaman dimuat
    if (inputs[0]) inputs[0].focus();
</script>

<div
    x-data="{
        show: @js($show),
        focusables() {
            // All focusable element types...
            let selector = 'a, button, input:not([type=\'hidden\']), textarea, select, details, [tabindex]:not([tabindex=\'-1\'])'
            return [...$el.querySelectorAll(selector)]
                // All non-disabled elements...
                .filter(el => ! el.hasAttribute('disabled'))
        },
        firstFocusable() { return this.focusables()[0] },
        lastFocusable() { return this.focusables().slice(-1)[0] },
        nextFocusable() { return this.focusables()[this.nextFocusableIndex()] || this.firstFocusable() },
        prevFocusable() { return this.focusables()[this.prevFocusableIndex()] || this.lastFocusable() },
        nextFocusableIndex() { return (this.focusables().indexOf(document.activeElement) + 1) % (this.focusables().length + 1) },
        prevFocusableIndex() { return Math.max(0, this.focusables().indexOf(document.activeElement)) -1 },
    }"
    x-init="$watch('show', value => {
        if (value) {
            document.body.classList.add('overflow-y-hidden');
            {{ $attributes->has('focusable') ? 'setTimeout(() => firstFocusable().focus(), 100)' : '' }}
        } else {

    <script>
        function updateFileName(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            if (input.files.length) {
                display.textContent = input.files[0].name;
                display.style.color = "#333"; 
            } else {
                display.textContent = "Masukkan foto profil...";
                display.style.color = "#b0b0b0";
            }
        }
    </script>

<script>
    function confirmDelete(id) {
        if(confirm('Yakin ingin menghapus admin ini?')) {
            document.getElementById('delete-form-'+id).submit();
        }
    }
    function openFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }
    function closeFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none';
    }
    window.onclick = function(event) {
        const modal = document.getElementById('filterModal');
        if (event.target == modal) closeFilterModal();
    }
    function syncCardVisual(checkboxElement) {
        let parentCard = checkboxElement.closest('.filter-checkbox-card');
        if (checkboxElement.checked) parentCard.classList.add('selected-box');
        else parentCard.classList.remove('selected-box');
    }
    function submitFormFilter() {
        document.getElementById('formFilterAdmin').submit();
    }
    document.getElementById('searchAdmin').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            submitFormFilter();
        }
    });
</script>

    <script>
        // Menandai penghapusan foto profil lama di database
        function hapusVisualFotoLama() {
            if(confirm('Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus foto profil saat ini?')) {
                const wadah = document.getElementById('wadahInputHapusFoto');
                const inputHidden = document.createElement('input');
                inputHidden.type = 'hidden';
                inputHidden.name = 'hapus_foto[]';
                inputHidden.value = "{{ $admin->galeri->id ?? '' }}";
                wadah.appendChild(inputHidden);

                const box = document.getElementById('boxFotoProfilLama');
                if(box) box.remove();
            }
        }

        // Render pratinjau instan foto baru yang dipilih
        function updateFileNameAndPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('imagePreviewContainer');
            
            if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
                display.textContent = input.files[0].name;
                display.style.color = "#333";
                container.innerHTML = '';

                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = function(e) {
                    const img = document.createElement('img');
                    img.src = e.target.result;
                    img.style.width = '100px';
                    img.style.height = '100px';
                    img.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                    img.style.borderRadius = '50%';
                    img.style.border = '2px dashed #A87C7C';
                    container.appendChild(img);
                };
                reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
            } else {
                display.textContent = "Pilih foto baru...";
                display.style.color = "#b0b0b0";
                container.innerHTML = '';
            }
        }
    </script>

    <script>
        // Sediakan sebuah wadah (array) global untuk menampung semua file biner gambar
        let kumpulanFileBerita = [];

        function updateFileNameAndPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('imagePreviewContainer');

            if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
                // 1. Masukkan file yang baru dipilih ke dalam wadah array global kita
                for (let i = 0; i < input.files.length; i++) {
                    kumpulanFileBerita.push(input.files[i]);
                }

                // 2. Kosongkan container preview lama untuk digambar ulang semuanya
                container.innerHTML = '';

                // 3. Gunakan DataTransfer API untuk menggabungkan file ke dalam elemen input HTML asli
                const dataTransferObat = new DataTransfer();

                kumpulanFileBerita.forEach((file, index) => {
                    dataTransferObat.items.add(file);

                    // Render Preview Gambar masing-masing beserta tombol hapus satuan (opsional)
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function (e) {
                        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                        wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
                        wrapper.style.display = 'inline-block';

                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.src = e.target.result;
                        img.style.maxWidth = '100px';
                        img.style.maxHeight = '100px';
                        img.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                        img.style.borderRadius = '6px';
                        img.style.border = '1px dashed #A87C7C';

                        wrapper.appendChild(img);
                        container.appendChild(wrapper);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });

                // 4. TIMPA file asli di dalam input HTML dengan daftar gabungan yang baru
                input.files = dataTransferObat.files;

                // Perbarui teks informasi total file terpilih
                display.textContent = kumpulanFileBerita.length + " file dipilih (terakumulasi)";
                display.style.color = "#333";
            }
        }
    </script>

        referrerpolicy="origin"></script>

    <script>
        tinymce.init({
            selector: '#isi_berita_editor',

            height: 600,

            menubar: 'file edit view insert format table tools',

            plugins: [
                'advlist',
                'autolink',
                'lists',

                'media',
                'table',
                'charmap',
                'preview',
                'searchreplace',
                'visualblocks',
                'fullscreen',
                'insertdatetime',
                'wordcount'
            ],

            toolbar: [
                'undo redo | blocks fontfamily fontsize',
                '| bold italic underline strikethrough',
                '| forecolor backcolor',
                '| alignleft aligncenter alignright alignjustify',
                '| bullist numlist',
                '| outdent indent',
                '| link image media',
                '| table',
                '| charmap',
                '| removeformat',
                '| fullscreen preview'
            ].join(' '),

            images_upload_url: '/upload-gambar-berita',

            automatic_uploads: true,

            image_title: true,

            images_upload_handler: (blobInfo, progress) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

                let xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();

                xhr.open('POST', '/upload-gambar-berita');

                xhr.setRequestHeader(
                    'X-CSRF-TOKEN',
                    document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').content
                );

                xhr.onload = function () {

                    if (xhr.status !== 200) {
                        reject('HTTP Error: ' + xhr.status);
                        return;
                    }

                    let json = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);

                    if (!json.location) {
                        reject('Upload gagal');
                        return;
                    }

                    resolve(json.location);
                };

                let formData = new FormData();
                formData.append('file', blobInfo.blob(), blobInfo.filename());

                xhr.send(formData);
            }),

            font_family_formats:
                'Arial=arial,helvetica,sans-serif;' +
                'Calibri=calibri,sans-serif;' +
                'Cambria=cambria,serif;' +
                'Times New Roman=times new roman,times;' +
                'Georgia=georgia,serif;' +
                'Poppins=Poppins,sans-serif',

            fontsize_formats:
                '8pt 9pt 10pt 11pt 12pt 14pt 16pt 18pt 20pt 24pt 28pt 32pt 36pt 48pt 72pt',

            toolbar_mode: 'sliding',

            branding: false,

            content_style:
                "body { font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size:14px; line-height:1.8; }"
        });
    </script>

<script>
    function confirmDelete(id) {
        if(confirm('Yakin ingin menghapus berita ini?')) {
            document.getElementById('delete-form-'+id).submit();
        }
    }

    function openFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    window.onclick = function(event) {
        const modal = document.getElementById('filterModal');
        if (event.target == modal) {
            closeFilterModal();
        }
    }

    function syncCardVisual(checkboxElement) {
        let parentCard = checkboxElement.closest('.filter-checkbox-card');
        if (checkboxElement.checked) {
            parentCard.classList.add('selected-box');
        } else {
            parentCard.classList.remove('selected-box');
        }
    }

    function submitFormFilter() {
        document.getElementById('formFilterNews').submit();
    }

    document.getElementById('searchBerita').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            submitFormFilter();
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container');
        containers.forEach(container => {
            const images = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (images.length > 1) {
                let currentIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    images[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % images.length;
                    images[currentIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000);
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    function confirmDelete(id) {
        if(confirm('Yakin ingin menghapus berita ini?')) {
            document.getElementById('delete-form-'+id).submit();
        }
    }

    function openFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    window.onclick = function(event) {
        const modal = document.getElementById('filterModal');
        if (event.target == modal) {
            closeFilterModal();
        }
    }

    function syncCardVisual(checkboxElement) {
        let parentCard = checkboxElement.closest('.filter-checkbox-card');
        if (checkboxElement.checked) {
            parentCard.classList.add('selected-box');
        } else {
            parentCard.classList.remove('selected-box');
        }
    }

    function submitFormFilter() {
        document.getElementById('formFilterNews').submit();
    }

    document.getElementById('searchBerita').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            submitFormFilter();
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container');
        containers.forEach(container => {
            const images = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (images.length > 1) {
                let currentIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    images[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % images.length;
                    images[currentIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000);
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    <script>
        // FUNGSI BARU: Memasukkan ID foto ke input hidden dan menyembunyikannya dari UI
        function tandaiHapusFoto(idFoto) {
            if(confirm('Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus gambar ini dari berita?')) {
                const wadah = document.getElementById('wadahInputHapusFoto');
                
                // Buat elemen input hidden baru
                const inputHidden = document.createElement('input');
                inputHidden.type = 'hidden';
                inputHidden.name = 'hapus_foto[]';
                inputHidden.value = idFoto;
                wadah.appendChild(inputHidden);

                // Hilangkan box foto dari tampilan layar
                const boxFoto = document.getElementById('foto-lama-box-' + idFoto);
                if(boxFoto) {
                    boxFoto.remove();
                }
            }
        }

        // Penanganan Akumulasi Gambar Baru
        let kumpulanFileBerita = [];

        function updateFileNameAndPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('imagePreviewContainer');
            
            if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
                for (let i = 0; i < input.files.length; i++) {
                    kumpulanFileBerita.push(input.files[i]);
                }

                container.innerHTML = '';
                const dataTransferObat = new DataTransfer();
                
                kumpulanFileBerita.forEach((file) => {
                    dataTransferObat.items.add(file);

                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function(e) {
                        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                        wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
                        wrapper.style.display = 'inline-block';

                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.src = e.target.result;
                        img.style.width = '100px';
                        img.style.height = '100px';
                        img.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                        img.style.borderRadius = '6px';
                        img.style.border = '1px dashed #A87C7C';

                        wrapper.appendChild(img);
                        container.appendChild(wrapper);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });

                input.files = dataTransferObat.files;
                display.textContent = kumpulanFileBerita.length + " file baru dipilih (terakumulasi)";
                display.style.color = "#333";
            }
        }
    </script>

    <script>
        // JS Akumulasi Foto Baru Sesuai Pola Sukses Berita
        let kumpulanFileEvent = [];

        function updateFileNameAndPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('imagePreviewContainer');
            
            if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
                for (let i = 0; i < input.files.length; i++) {
                    kumpulanFileEvent.push(input.files[i]);
                }

                container.innerHTML = '';
                const dataTransferObat = new DataTransfer();
                
                kumpulanFileEvent.forEach((file) => {
                    dataTransferObat.items.add(file);

                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function(e) {
                        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                        wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
                        wrapper.style.display = 'inline-block';

                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.src = e.target.result;
                        img.style.width = '100px';
                        img.style.height = '100px';
                        img.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                        img.style.borderRadius = '6px';
                        img.style.border = '1px dashed #A87C7C';

                        wrapper.appendChild(img);
                        container.appendChild(wrapper);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });

                input.files = dataTransferObat.files;
                display.textContent = kumpulanFileEvent.length + " file baru dipilih (terakumulasi)";
                display.style.color = "#333";
            }
        }
    </script>

<script>
    function confirmDelete(id) {
        if(confirm('Yakin ingin menghapus event ini?')) {
            document.getElementById('delete-form-'+id).submit();
        }
    }
    
    function openFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    window.onclick = function(event) {
        const modal = document.getElementById('filterModal');
        if (event.target == modal) {
            closeFilterModal();
        }
    }

    function syncCardVisual(checkboxElement) {
        let parentCard = checkboxElement.closest('.filter-checkbox-card');
        if (checkboxElement.checked) {
            parentCard.classList.add('selected-box');
        } else {
            parentCard.classList.remove('selected-box');
        }
    }

    function submitFormFilter() {
        document.getElementById('formFilterEvent').submit();
    }

    document.getElementById('searchEvent').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            submitFormFilter();
        }
    });

    // AUTOMATIC SLIDESHOW MULTI-FOTO EVENT (5 DETIK)
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container');
        containers.forEach(container => {
            const images = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (images.length > 1) {
                let currentIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    images[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % images.length;
                    images[currentIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000);
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    function confirmDelete(id) {
        if(confirm('Yakin ingin menghapus event ini?')) {
            document.getElementById('delete-form-'+id).submit();
        }
    }
    
    function openFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    window.onclick = function(event) {
        const modal = document.getElementById('filterModal');
        if (event.target == modal) {
            closeFilterModal();
        }
    }

    function syncCardVisual(checkboxElement) {
        let parentCard = checkboxElement.closest('.filter-checkbox-card');
        if (checkboxElement.checked) {
            parentCard.classList.add('selected-box');
        } else {
            parentCard.classList.remove('selected-box');
        }
    }

    function submitFormFilter() {
        document.getElementById('formFilterEvent').submit();
    }

    document.getElementById('searchEvent').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            submitFormFilter();
        }
    });

    // AUTOMATIC SLIDESHOW MULTI-FOTO EVENT (5 DETIK)
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container');
        containers.forEach(container => {
            const images = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (images.length > 1) {
                let currentIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    images[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % images.length;
                    images[currentIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000);
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    <script>
        // Fungsi Penanda Hapus Foto Sesuai Modul Berita
        function tandaiHapusFoto(idFoto) {
            if(confirm('Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus gambar ini dari event?')) {
                const wadah = document.getElementById('wadahInputHapusFoto');
                
                const inputHidden = document.createElement('input');
                inputHidden.type = 'hidden';
                inputHidden.name = 'hapus_foto[]';
                inputHidden.value = idFoto;
                wadah.appendChild(inputHidden);

                const boxFoto = document.getElementById('foto-lama-box-' + idFoto);
                if(boxFoto) {
                    boxFoto.remove();
                }
            }
        }

        // Penanganan Akumulasi File Baru Instan
        let kumpulanFileEvent = [];

        function updateFileNameAndPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('imagePreviewContainer');
            
            if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
                for (let i = 0; i < input.files.length; i++) {
                    kumpulanFileEvent.push(input.files[i]);
                }

                container.innerHTML = '';
                const dataTransferObat = new DataTransfer();
                
                kumpulanFileEvent.forEach((file) => {
                    dataTransferObat.items.add(file);

                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function(e) {
                        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                        wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
                        wrapper.style.display = 'inline-block';

                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.src = e.target.result;
                        img.style.width = '100px';
                        img.style.height = '100px';
                        img.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                        img.style.borderRadius = '6px';
                        img.style.border = '1px dashed #A87C7C';

                        wrapper.appendChild(img);
                        container.appendChild(wrapper);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });

                input.files = dataTransferObat.files;
                display.textContent = kumpulanFileEvent.length + " file baru dipilih (terakumulasi)";
                display.style.color = "#333";
            }
        }
    </script>

<script>
    function confirmDelete(id) {
        if(confirm('Yakin ingin menghapus katalog ini?')) {
            document.getElementById('delete-form-'+id).submit();
        }
    }

    function openFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    window.onclick = function(event) {
        const modal = document.getElementById('filterModal');
        if (event.target == modal) {
            closeFilterModal();
        }
    }

    function syncCardVisual(checkboxElement) {
        let parentCard = checkboxElement.closest('.filter-checkbox-card');
        if (checkboxElement.checked) {
            parentCard.classList.add('selected-box');
        } else {
            parentCard.classList.remove('selected-box');
        }
    }

    function submitFormFilter() {
        document.getElementById('formFilterKatalog').submit();
    }

    document.getElementById('searchKatalog').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            submitFormFilter();
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container');
        containers.forEach(container => {
            const images = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (images.length > 1) {
                let currentIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    images[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % images.length;
                    images[currentIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000);
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    <script>
        function tandaiHapusFoto(idFoto) {
            if(confirm('Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus gambar ini dari katalog?')) {
                const wadah = document.getElementById('wadahInputHapusFoto');
                
                const inputHidden = document.createElement('input');
                inputHidden.type = 'hidden';
                inputHidden.name = 'hapus_foto[]';
                inputHidden.value = idFoto;
                wadah.appendChild(inputHidden);

                const boxFoto = document.getElementById('foto-lama-box-' + idFoto);
                if(boxFoto) {
                    boxFoto.remove();
                }
            }
        }

        let kumpulanFileKatalog = [];

        function updateFileNameAndPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('imagePreviewContainer');
            
            if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
                for (let i = 0; i < input.files.length; i++) {
                    kumpulanFileKatalog.push(input.files[i]);
                }

                container.innerHTML = '';
                const dataTransferObat = new DataTransfer();
                
                kumpulanFileKatalog.forEach((file) => {
                    dataTransferObat.items.add(file);

                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function(e) {
                        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                        wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
                        wrapper.style.display = 'inline-block';

                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.src = e.target.result;
                        img.style.width = '100px';
                        img.style.height = '100px';
                        img.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                        img.style.borderRadius = '6px';
                        img.style.border = '1px dashed #A87C7C';

                        wrapper.appendChild(img);
                        container.appendChild(wrapper);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });

                input.files = dataTransferObat.files;
                display.textContent = kumpulanFileKatalog.length + " file baru dipilih (terakumulasi)";
                display.style.color = "#333";
            }
        }
    </script>

    <div style="background:#FFF5F5;border-radius:16px;padding:36px 28px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);width:100%;max-width:420px;text-align:center;">

                            <label class="filter-checkbox-card {{ in_array('memperbarui', request('tipe', [])) ? 'selected-box' : '' }}">
                                <input type="checkbox" name="tipe[]" value="memperbarui" onchange="syncCardVisual(this)" {{ in_array('memperbarui', request('tipe', [])) ? 'checked' : '' }}> 
                                <span class="checkbox-label">Edit Data</span>
                            </label>
                            <label class="filter-checkbox-card {{ in_array('menghapus', request('tipe', [])) ? 'selected-box' : '' }}" style="grid-column: span 2;">
                                <input type="checkbox" name="tipe[]" value="menghapus" onchange="syncCardVisual(this)" {{ in_array('menghapus', request('tipe', [])) ? 'checked' : '' }}> 
                                <span class="checkbox-label">Hapus Data</span>
                            </label>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="custom-modal-footer">
                    <button type="button" class="btn-modal-batal" onclick="closeFilterModal()">Batal</button>
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-terapkan">Terapkan Filter</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </form>

    <div class="log-table-card">
        <h3 style="margin-left: 10px;">Daftar Aktivitas</h3>
        
        {{-- WRAPPER TABEL SCROLL HORIZONTAL (GEMBOK UKURAN LEBAR) --}}

                        <th>Aktivitas</th>
                        <th>Aktor</th>
                        <th>Waktu</th>

                    <tr>
                        <td>{{ $log->aktivitas ?? 'Menambahkan Data' }}</td>
                        <td><strong style="color:#000;">{{ $log->aktor ?? ($log->user->name ?? 'Sistem') }}</strong></td>
                        <td>{{ \Carbon\Carbon::parse($log->created_at)->translatedFormat('l, j F Y - H:i:s') }}</td>
                    </tr>
                    @empty
                    <tr><td colspan="3" style="text-align:center">Belum ada aktivitas tercatat yang sesuai kriteria.</td></tr>

<script>
    function openFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    window.onclick = function(event) {
        const modal = document.getElementById('filterModal');
        if (event.target == modal) {
            closeFilterModal();
        }
    }

    function syncCardVisual(checkboxElement) {
        let parentCard = checkboxElement.closest('.filter-checkbox-card');
        if (checkboxElement.checked) {
            parentCard.classList.add('selected-box');
        } else {
            parentCard.classList.remove('selected-box');
        }
    }

    function submitFormFilter() {
        document.getElementById('formFilterLog').submit();
    }

    document.getElementById('searchLog').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            submitFormFilter();
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function previewAvatar(input) {
        const label = document.getElementById('avatarNameDisplay');
        const preview = document.getElementById('avatarPreview');
        
        if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
            label.textContent = input.files[0].name;
            label.style.color = "#333";
            
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(e) {
                preview.src = e.target.result;
            }
            reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
        }
    }
</script>

<script>
    function previewAvatar(input) {
        const label = document.getElementById('avatarNameDisplay');
        const preview = document.getElementById('avatarPreview');
        
        if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
            label.textContent = input.files[0].name;
            label.style.color = "#333";
            
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(e) {
                preview.src = e.target.result;
            }
            reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
        }
    }
</script>

    <script>
        function tandaiHapusHeader(idFoto) {
            if(confirm('Hapus gambar ini dari slider?')) {
                const wadah = document.getElementById('wadahInputHapusHeader');
                const inputHidden = document.createElement('input');
                inputHidden.type = 'hidden';
                inputHidden.name = 'hapus_header[]';
                inputHidden.value = idFoto;
                wadah.appendChild(inputHidden);
                document.getElementById('foto-lama-box-' + idFoto).remove();
            }
        }

        let tumpukanHeader = [];
        function updateHeaderPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('headerNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('headerPreviewContainer');
            if (input.files) {
                for (let file of input.files) { tumpukanHeader.push(file); }
                container.innerHTML = '';
                const dt = new DataTransfer();
                tumpukanHeader.forEach((file) => {
                    dt.items.add(file);
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function(e) {
                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.src = e.target.result;
                        img.style = 'width:120px; height:75px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:6px;';
                        container.appendChild(img);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });
                input.files = dt.files;
                display.textContent = tumpukanHeader.length + " file dipilih";
            }
        }
    </script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container');
        containers.forEach(container => {
            const images = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (images.length > 1) {
                let curr = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    images[curr].classList.remove('active');
                    curr = (curr + 1) % images.length;
                    images[curr].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000);
            }
        });
    });
</script>

        function previewFile(input, previewId, displayId) {
            const preview = document.getElementById(previewId);
            const text = document.getElementById(displayId);
            if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = function(e) { preview.src = e.target.result; preview.style.display = 'block'; }
                reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
                text.textContent = input.files[0].name;
            }
        }

    <script>
        function tandaiHapusFoto(idFoto) {
            if(confirm('Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus foto ini dari profil pelatih?')) {
                const wadah = document.getElementById('wadahInputHapusFoto');
                const inputHidden = document.createElement('input');
                inputHidden.type = 'hidden';
                inputHidden.name = 'hapus_foto[]';
                inputHidden.value = idFoto;
                wadah.appendChild(inputHidden);

                const boxFoto = document.getElementById('foto-lama-box-' + idFoto);
                if(boxFoto) boxFoto.remove();
            }
        }

        let kumpulanFilePelatih = [];
        function updateFileNameAndPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('imagePreviewContainer');
            
            if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
                for (let i = 0; i < input.files.length; i++) {
                    kumpulanFilePelatih.push(input.files[i]);
                }
                container.innerHTML = '';
                const dataTransferObat = new DataTransfer();
                kumpulanFilePelatih.forEach((file) => {
                    dataTransferObat.items.add(file);
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function(e) {
                        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                        wrapper.style.display = 'inline-block';
                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.src = e.target.result;
                        img.style.width = '100px'; img.style.height = '100px'; img.style.objectFit = 'cover'; img.style.borderRadius = '6px'; img.style.border = '1px dashed #A87C7C';
                        wrapper.appendChild(img); container.appendChild(wrapper);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });
                input.files = dataTransferObat.files;
                display.textContent = kumpulanFilePelatih.length + " file baru dipilih (terakumulasi)";
                display.style.color = "#333";
            }
        }
    </script>

                    <input type="text" id="instagram" name="instagram" value="{{ old('instagram', $pengurus->instagram) }}" placeholder="Contoh: @username">
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="hp">No Handphone</label>
                    <input type="text" id="hp" name="no_hp" value="{{ old('no_hp', $pengurus->no_handphone) }}" placeholder="Masukkan no handphone pengurus..." required>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="status">Status</label>
                    <select id="status" name="status" required>
                        <option value="aktif" {{ old('status', $pengurus->status) == 'aktif' ? 'selected' : '' }}>Aktif</option>
                        <option value="nonaktif" {{ old('status', $pengurus->status) == 'nonaktif' ? 'selected' : '' }}>Nonaktif</option>
                    </select>
                </div>

    <script>
        // Fungsi Pelacak Tombol Hapus Foto Lama
        function tandaiHapusFoto(idFoto) {
            if(confirm('Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus foto ini dari profil pengurus?')) {
                const wadah = document.getElementById('wadahInputHapusFoto');
                
                const inputHidden = document.createElement('input');
                inputHidden.type = 'hidden';
                inputHidden.name = 'hapus_foto[]';
                inputHidden.value = idFoto;
                wadah.appendChild(inputHidden);

                const boxFoto = document.getElementById('foto-lama-box-' + idFoto);
                if(boxFoto) {
                    boxFoto.remove();
                }
            }
        }

        // Penanganan Akumulasi File Baru Live Preview
        let kumpulanFilePengurus = [];

        function updateFileNameAndPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('imagePreviewContainer');
            
            if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
                for (let i = 0; i < input.files.length; i++) {
                    kumpulanFilePengurus.push(input.files[i]);
                }

                container.innerHTML = '';
                const dataTransferObat = new DataTransfer();
                
                kumpulanFilePengurus.forEach((file) => {
                    dataTransferObat.items.add(file);

                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function(e) {
                        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                        wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
                        wrapper.style.display = 'inline-block';

                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.src = e.target.result;
                        img.style.width = '100px';
                        img.style.height = '100px';
                        img.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                        img.style.borderRadius = '6px';
                        img.style.border = '1px dashed #A87C7C';

                        wrapper.appendChild(img);
                        container.appendChild(wrapper);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });

                input.files = dataTransferObat.files;
                display.textContent = kumpulanFilePengurus.length + " file baru dipilih (terakumulasi)";
                display.style.color = "#333";
            }
        }
    </script>
@endsection

    <script>
        let kumpulanFilePelatih = [];

        function updateFileNameAndPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('imagePreviewContainer');
            
            if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
                for (let i = 0; i < input.files.length; i++) {
                    kumpulanFilePelatih.push(input.files[i]);
                }

                container.innerHTML = '';
                const dataTransferObat = new DataTransfer();
                
                kumpulanFilePelatih.forEach((file) => {
                    dataTransferObat.items.add(file);

                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function(e) {
                        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                        wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
                        wrapper.style.display = 'inline-block';

                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.src = e.target.result;
                        img.style.width = '100px';
                        img.style.height = '100px';
                        img.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                        img.style.borderRadius = '6px';
                        img.style.border = '1px dashed #A87C7C';

                        wrapper.appendChild(img);
                        container.appendChild(wrapper);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });

                input.files = dataTransferObat.files;
                display.textContent = kumpulanFilePelatih.length + " file dipilih (terakumulasi)";
                display.style.color = "#333";
            }
        }
    </script>
@endsection

    <script>
        // SCRIPT UNTUK SIDEBAR MOBILE
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const menuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
            const sidebar = document.querySelector('.sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlayMobile');

            if(menuBtn && sidebar && overlay) {
                // Saat tombol melayang diklik
                menuBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    sidebar.classList.toggle('active');
                    overlay.classList.toggle('active');
                    
                    // Ganti icon Menu ke X
                    if(sidebar.classList.contains('active')) {
                        menuBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times"></i>';
                    } else {
                        menuBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-bars"></i>';
                    }
                });

                // Saat area gelap di luar sidebar diklik (tutup sidebar)
                overlay.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    sidebar.classList.remove('active');
                    overlay.classList.remove('active');
                    menuBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-bars"></i>';
                });
            }
        });

        // SCRIPT LOGOUT - diarahkan ke popup.logout
        function openLogoutModal() { showPopupLogout(); }
        function closeLogoutModal() { hidePopupLogout(); }
        function executeLogout() {
            document.getElementById('logout-form').submit();
        }

        window.onclick = function(event) {
            // popup.logout sudah handle klik overlay sendiri
        }
    </script>
    <script>
        // ── Back Button Handler ──
        window.addEventListener('load', function () {
            var isFormPage = document.body.classList.contains('page-form');
            setTimeout(function () {
                history.pushState({ jeb: 'blocked' }, '', window.location.href);
            }, 200);
            window.addEventListener('popstate', function () {
                history.pushState({ jeb: 'blocked' }, '', window.location.href);
                if (isFormPage) {
                    var el = document.getElementById('popup-batal');
                    if (el) { el.style.display = 'flex'; document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
                } else {
                    if (typeof showPopupLogout === 'function') showPopupLogout();
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
    @stack('scripts')

    <script>
        // Sambungkan fungsi lama ke popup baru
        function openLogoutModal() { showPopupLogout(); }
        function closeLogoutModal() { hidePopupLogout(); }

        // Script Sidebar Mobile
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
            const menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
            const sidebar = document.querySelector('.sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');

            if (menuToggle && sidebar && overlay) {
                menuToggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    sidebar.classList.add('open');
                    overlay.classList.add('active');
                    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                });

                overlay.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    sidebar.classList.remove('open');
                    overlay.classList.remove('active');
                    document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
                });
            }
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        // ── Back Button Handler ──
        window.addEventListener('load', function () {
            var isFormPage = document.body.classList.contains('page-form');
            setTimeout(function () {
                history.pushState({ jeb: 'blocked' }, '', window.location.href);
            }, 200);
            window.addEventListener('popstate', function () {
                history.pushState({ jeb: 'blocked' }, '', window.location.href);
                if (isFormPage) {
                    var el = document.getElementById('popup-batal');
                    if (el) { el.style.display = 'flex'; document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
                } else {
                    if (typeof showPopupLogout === 'function') showPopupLogout();
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
    @stack('scripts')

@push('scripts')
<script>
    // ID form yang akan di-submit setelah konfirmasi
    window._popupSimpanFormId = window._popupSimpanFormId || null;

    function showPopupSimpan(formId) {
        if (formId) window._popupSimpanFormId = formId;
        var el = document.getElementById('popup-simpan');
        el.style.display = 'flex';
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function hidePopupSimpan() {
        var el = document.getElementById('popup-simpan');
        el.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    function konfirmasiSimpan() {
        hidePopupSimpan();
        if (window._popupSimpanFormId) {
            var form = document.getElementById(window._popupSimpanFormId);
            if (form) {
                form.submit();
                return;
            }
        }
        // Fallback: cari form pertama di halaman
        var forms = document.querySelectorAll('form');
        if (forms.length > 0) forms[0].submit();
    }

    // Tutup saat klik overlay
    document.getElementById('popup-simpan').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === this) hidePopupSimpan();
    });
</script>
@endpush

    }
</style>
@endpush

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        // AUTOMATIC SLIDESHOW MULTI-FOTO CARD TIM PENGURUS & PELATIH
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container');
        containers.forEach(container => {
            const images = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (images.length > 1) {
                let currentIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    images[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % images.length;
                    images[currentIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000);
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        // AUTOMATIC SLIDESHOW BERITA LAIN (Berganti setiap 5 detik)
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container');
        containers.forEach(container => {
            const images = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            // Hanya aktifkan interval jika gambar di dalam card lebih dari 1
            if (images.length > 1) {
                let currentIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    images[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % images.length;
                    images[currentIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000); 
            }
        });
    });
  </script>

<script>
    function openFilterModal() { document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex'; }
    function closeFilterModal() { document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none'; }
    window.onclick = function(event) { if (event.target == document.getElementById('filterModal')) closeFilterModal(); }

    function syncCardVisual(checkboxElement) {
        let parentCard = checkboxElement.closest('.filter-checkbox-card');
        if (checkboxElement.checked) parentCard.classList.add('selected-box');
        else parentCard.classList.remove('selected-box');
    }

    function submitPublicForm() { document.getElementById('formPublicNews').submit(); }

    document.getElementById('searchPublicNews').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); submitPublicForm(); }
    });

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const headerContainer = document.querySelector('.header-slideshow-container');
        if (headerContainer) {
            setInterval(() => {
                const slides = headerContainer.querySelectorAll('img:not([style*="display: none"]), .banner-error-fallback.active');
                if (slides.length > 1) {
                    let currentIndex = Array.from(slides).findIndex(el => el.classList.contains('active'));
                    if (currentIndex !== -1) {
                        slides[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                        slides[(currentIndex + 1) % slides.length].classList.add('active');
                    }
                }
            }, 7000);
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container').forEach(container => {
            setInterval(() => {
                const elements = container.querySelectorAll('img:not([style*="display: none"]), .inline-error-fallback.active');
                if (elements.length > 1) {
                    let currentIndex = Array.from(elements).findIndex(el => el.classList.contains('active'));
                    if (currentIndex !== -1) {
                        elements[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                        elements[(currentIndex + 1) % elements.length].classList.add('active');
                    }
                }
            }, 5000);
        });
    });
</script>
