{{-- JAVASCRIPT SYSTEM AUTOMATIC SLIDESHOW --}}
<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        // 1. Slideshow untuk Foto Utama Event (7 Detik)
        const mainContainer = document.querySelector('.slideshow-container-main');
        if (mainContainer) {
            const mainImages = mainContainer.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (mainImages.length > 1) {
                let mainIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    mainImages[mainIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    mainIndex = (mainIndex + 1) % mainImages.length;
                    mainImages[mainIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 7000);
            }
        }

        // 2. Slideshow untuk Setiap Kartu Event Lainnya (5 Detik)
        const miniContainers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container-mini');
        miniContainers.forEach(container => {
            const miniImages = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (miniImages.length > 1) {
                let miniIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    miniImages[miniIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    miniIndex = (miniIndex + 1) % miniImages.length;
                    miniImages[miniIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000);
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    function openFilterModal() { document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex'; }
    function closeFilterModal() { document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none'; }
    
    window.onclick = function(e) { 
        if (e.target == document.getElementById('filterModal')) closeFilterModal(); 
    }

    function syncCardVisual(c) { 
        let p = c.closest('.filter-checkbox-card'); 
        if (c.checked) p.classList.add('selected-box'); else p.classList.remove('selected-box'); 
    }

    function submitPublicForm() { document.getElementById('formPublicEvent').submit(); }
    
    document.getElementById('searchPublicEvent').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) { 
        if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); submitPublicForm(); } 
    });

    const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

    // AMBIL DATA ACARA DINAMIS DARI CONTROLLER VIA $allEvents
    const masterEventsDatabase = [
        @if(isset($allEvents))
            @foreach($allEvents as $e)
            {
                id: "{{ $e->id }}",
                title: "{{ $e->nama }}",
                excerpt: "{{ Str::limit(strip_tags($e->deskripsi), 120) }}",
                date: "{{ \Carbon\Carbon::parse($e->tanggal)->format('Y-m-d') }}", 
                formattedDate: "{{ \Carbon\Carbon::parse($e->tanggal)->translatedFormat('d M Y') }}",
                lokasi: "{{ Str::limit($e->lokasi, 22) }}",
                jam: "{{ \Carbon\Carbon::parse($e->jam)->format('H:i') }} WIB",
                urlDetail: "{{ route('umum.event-detail', $e->id) }}",
                galeriHTML: `@if($e->galeri && $e->galeri->isNotEmpty())
                                @foreach($e->galeri as $index => $f)
                                    <img src="{{ asset('storage/' . $f->path) }}" class="{{ $index === 0 ? 'active' : '' }}">
                                @endforeach
                             @else
                                <img src="{{ asset('img/images-landing-page/banner_berita.jpeg') }}" class="active">
                             @endif`
            },
            @endforeach
        @endif
    ];

    const daftarTanggalAcara = masterEventsDatabase.map(item => item.date);

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const calendarEl = document.getElementById('calendar-box');

        const calendar = new FullCalendar.Calendar(calendarEl, {
            initialView: 'dayGridMonth',
            locale: 'id',
            height: 'auto',
            headerToolbar: {
                left: 'title',
                center: '',
                right: 'prev,next'
            },
            events: masterEventsDatabase,

            dayCellDidMount: function(info) {
                let tahun = info.date.getFullYear();
                let bulan = String(info.date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
                let hari = String(info.date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
                let stringTanggalCell = `${tahun}-${bulan}-${hari}`;
                
                if (stringTanggalCell === todayStr) {
                    info.el.classList.add('fc-day-today-custom');
                }

                if (daftarTanggalAcara.includes(stringTanggalCell)) {
                    if (stringTanggalCell < todayStr) {
                        info.el.classList.add('fc-day-has-event-past');
                    } 
                    else {
                        info.el.classList.add('fc-day-has-event-future');
                    }
                }
            },

            dateClick: function(info) {
                const tanggalKlik = info.dateStr; 
                const wadahRender = document.getElementById('event-render-container');
                const wadahPaginasi = document.getElementById('paginasi-container-wrapper');
                const indikatorHeader = document.getElementById('header-filter-tanggal');
                const labelTanggal = document.getElementById('label-tanggal-pilihan');

                const hasilSaring = masterEventsDatabase.filter(ev => ev.date === tanggalKlik);

                const pecahan = tanggalKlik.split('-');
                labelTanggal.textContent = `${pecahan[2]}-${pecahan[1]}-${pecahan[0]}`;
                indikatorHeader.style.display = 'flex';
                wadahPaginasi.style.display = 'none';

                if (hasilSaring.length > 0) {
                    let kartuHTML = '';
                    hasilSaring.forEach(item => {
                        kartuHTML += `
                            <a href="${item.urlDetail}" class="event-item-card">
                                <div class="event-slideshow-box slideshow-container-mini">
                                    ${item.galeriHTML}
                                </div>
                                <div class="event-details-box">
                                    <div>
                                        <h4>${item.title}</h4>
                                        <div class="event-desc-excerpt">${item.excerpt}</div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="event-meta-info">
                                        <span><i class="far fa-calendar-alt" style="color: #3D0C0C;"></i> ${item.formattedDate}</span>
                                        <span><i class="fas fa-map-marker-alt" style="color: #3D0C0C;"></i> ${item.lokasi}</span>
                                        <span><i class="far fa-clock" style="color: #3D0C0C;"></i> ${item.jam}</span>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </a>`;
                    });
                    wadahRender.innerHTML = kartuHTML;
                    inisialisasiUlangSlideshowMini();
                } else {
                    wadahRender.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="empty-state-box" style="text-align: center; padding: 50px 20px; color: #7f8c8d; border: 1px dashed #DDD; border-radius: 16px; width: 100%;">
                            <p style="font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0;">Tidak ada acara</p>
                            <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #888; margin-top: 5px;">Tidak ada jadwal agenda kegiatan sanggar pada tanggal ini.</p>
                        </div>`;
                }
            }
        });
        
        calendar.render();

        // Logika Pengatur Slideshow Foto Mini (Interval 5 detik)
        let intervalSlideshowMini;
        function inisialisasiUlangSlideshowMini() {
            if(intervalSlideshowMini) clearInterval(intervalSlideshowMini);
            
            const miniContainers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container-mini');
            miniContainers.forEach(container => {
                const miniImages = container.querySelectorAll('img');
                if (miniImages.length > 1) {
                    let miniIndex = 0;
                    intervalSlideshowMini = setInterval(() => {
                        miniImages[miniIndex].classList.remove('active');
                        miniIndex = (miniIndex + 1) % miniImages.length;
                        miniImages[miniIndex].classList.add('active');
                    }, 5000);
                }
            });
        }
        
        inisialisasiUlangSlideshowMini();

        // Banner Hero Slideshow 
        const headerContainer = document.querySelector('.header-slideshow-container');
        if (headerContainer) {
            setInterval(() => {
                const slides = headerContainer.querySelectorAll('img:not([style*="display: none"]), .banner-error-fallback.active');
                if (slides.length > 1) {
                    let currentIndex = Array.from(slides).findIndex(el => el.classList.contains('active'));
                    if (currentIndex !== -1) {
                        slides[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                        slides[(currentIndex + 1) % slides.length].classList.add('active');
                    }
                }
            }, 7000);
        }
    });
</script>
@endsection@extends('layouts.umum')

@section('content')
<div class="galeri-detail-wrapper">
    <div class="detail-container">
        
    <div class="hero-image-card">
        {{-- IMAGE BOX UTAMA (STORAGE PENYIMPANAN) --}}
        <div class="hero-image-box">
            <img src="{{ asset('storage/' . $galeriUtama->path) }}" alt="{{ $galeriUtama->nama_file }}" onerror="this.src='{{ asset('img/images-landing-page/banner_berita.jpeg') }}';">
            <span class="category-badge">{{ $galeriUtama->kategori }}</span>
        </div>

        @php
        // Inisialisasi variabel fallback default
        $judulTeks = 'Dokumentasi ' . ucwords(str_replace('_', ' ', pathinfo($galeriUtama->nama_file, PATHINFO_FILENAME)));
        $tanggalTeks = \Carbon\Carbon::parse($galeriUtama->created_at)->translatedFormat('d F Y');
        $lokasiTeks = 'Lokasi Sanggar JEB';
        $jamTeks = null;
        $deskripsiTeks = 'Dokumentasi resmi dari Sanggar Tari Jiwa Etnik Blambangan (JEB) menampilkan keindahan gerak, busana adat tradisional, dan ekspresi budaya khas masyarakat Bumi Blambangan.';

        // Pengkondisian nama dinamis berdasarkan Kategori Galeri
        $kategoriTerpilih = strtolower($galeriUtama->kategori);

        if ($kategoriTerpilih === 'event' && isset($galeriUtama->event)) {
            $judulTeks = $galeriUtama->event->nama;
            $tanggalTeks = \Carbon\Carbon::parse($galeriUtama->event->tanggal)->translatedFormat('d F Y');
            $lokasiTeks = $galeriUtama->event->lokasi ?? $lokasiTeks;
            $jamTeks = $galeriUtama->event->jam ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($galeriUtama->event->jam)->format('H:i') . ' WIB' : null;
            $deskripsiTeks = $galeriUtama->event->deskripsi ?? $deskripsiTeks;

        } elseif ($kategoriTerpilih === 'katalog' && isset($galeriUtama->katalog)) {
            // DIUBAH: Langsung mengambil nama tarian tanpa teks "Kostum / Alat:"
            $judulTeks = $galeriUtama->katalog->nama_katalog; 
            $lokasiTeks = 'Koleksi Sanggar JEB (Stok: ' . $galeriUtama->katalog->stok . ')';
            $deskripsiTeks = $galeriUtama->katalog->deskripsi ?? $deskripsiTeks;

        } elseif ($kategoriTerpilih === 'berita' && isset($galeriUtama->berita)) {
            $judulTeks = $galeriUtama->berita->judul;
            $tanggalTeks = \Carbon\Carbon::parse($galeriUtama->berita->tgl_terbit ?? $galeriUtama->berita->created_at)->translatedFormat('d F Y');

<script>
    function openFilterModal() { document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex'; }
    function closeFilterModal() { document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none'; }
    window.onclick = function(e) { if (e.target == document.getElementById('filterModal')) closeFilterModal(); }
    function syncCardVisual(c) { let p = c.closest('.filter-checkbox-card'); if (c.checked) p.classList.add('selected-box'); else p.classList.remove('selected-box'); }
    function submitPublicForm() { document.getElementById('formPublicGaleri').submit(); }
    document.getElementById('searchPublicGaleri').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); submitPublicForm(); } });

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const headerContainer = document.querySelector('.header-slideshow-container');
        if (headerContainer) {
            setInterval(() => {
                const slides = headerContainer.querySelectorAll('img:not([style*="display: none"]), .banner-error-fallback.active');
                if (slides.length > 1) {
                    let currentIndex = Array.from(slides).findIndex(el => el.classList.contains('active'));
                    if (currentIndex !== -1) {
                        slides[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                        slides[(currentIndex + 1) % slides.length].classList.add('active');
                    }
                }
            }, 7000);
        }
    });
</script>

                $sistemDetail = \App\Models\PengaturanSistem::first();
                
                // Ambil nomor WhatsApp dari DB
                if ($sistemDetail && $sistemDetail->link_wa) {
                    $whatsappNumber = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $sistemDetail->link_wa);
                } else {
                    $whatsappNumber = '6282232505355';
                }

                // Ambil URL halaman katalog saat ini secara dinamis
                $urlKatalog = request()->url();

                // Menyusun template teks draf pesan (Menggunakan \n untuk baris baru)
                $pesanTeks = "Halo Admin Jiwa Etnik Blambangan,\n\n"
                           . "Saya ingin menanyakan tentang penyewaan *" . $katalog->nama_katalog . "*\n"
                           . "• Jumlah sebanyak: \n"
                           . "• Untuk tanggal pemakaian: \n\n"
                           . "Berikut adalah link produk katalog yang saya maksud:\n"
                           . $urlKatalog;

                // Enkripsi teks agar aman dibaca oleh browser sebagai query string URL
                $urlPesanEnkripsi = urlencode($pesanTeks);
            @endphp

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        // 1. Automatic Slideshow Gambar Utama (7 Detik)
        const mainContainer = document.querySelector('.slideshow-container-main');
        if (mainContainer) {
            const mainImages = mainContainer.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (mainImages.length > 1) {
                let mainIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    mainImages[mainIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    mainIndex = (mainIndex + 1) % mainImages.length;
                    mainImages[mainIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 7000);
            }
        }

        // 2. Automatic Slideshow Mini-Card Rekomendasi (5 Detik)
        const miniContainers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container-mini');
        miniContainers.forEach(container => {
            const miniImages = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (miniImages.length > 1) {
                let miniIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    miniImages[miniIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    miniIndex = (miniIndex + 1) % miniImages.length;
                    miniImages[miniIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000);
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    function openFilterModal() { document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex'; }
    function closeFilterModal() { document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none'; }
    window.onclick = function(event) { if (event.target == document.getElementById('filterModal')) closeFilterModal(); }
    function syncCardVisual(c) { let p = c.closest('.filter-checkbox-card'); if (c.checked) p.classList.add('selected-box'); else p.classList.remove('selected-box'); }
    function submitPublicForm() { document.getElementById('formPublicKatalog').submit(); }
    document.getElementById('searchPublicKatalog').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); submitPublicForm(); } });

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const headerContainer = document.querySelector('.header-slideshow-container');
        if (headerContainer) {
            setInterval(() => {
                const slides = headerContainer.querySelectorAll('img:not([style*="display: none"]), .banner-error-fallback.active');
                if (slides.length > 1) {
                    let currentIndex = Array.from(slides).findIndex(el => el.classList.contains('active'));
                    if (currentIndex !== -1) {
                        slides[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                        slides[(currentIndex + 1) % slides.length].classList.add('active');
                    }
                }
            }, 7000);
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        // 1. BANNER SLIDESHOW UTAMA
        const headerContainer = document.querySelector('.header-slideshow-container');
        if (headerContainer) {
            setInterval(() => {
                const slides = headerContainer.querySelectorAll('img:not([style*="display: none"]), .banner-error-fallback.active');
                if (slides.length > 1) {
                    let currentIndex = Array.from(slides).findIndex(el => el.classList.contains('active'));
                    if (currentIndex !== -1) {
                        slides[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                        slides[(currentIndex + 1) % slides.length].classList.add('active');
                    }
                }
            }, 7000);
        }

        // 2. AUTOMATIC SLIDESHOW MULTI-FOTO CARD PERSONEL (5 DETIK)
        // Berjalan dinamis menyapu semua container profile-card yang mempunyai class .slideshow-container
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container');
        containers.forEach(container => {
            const images = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (images.length > 1) {
                let currentIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    images[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % images.length;
                    images[currentIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000); // Berganti otomatis setiap 5 detik
            }
        });
    });
</script>

Route::get('/dashboard', function () {
     $user = auth()->user();
    
    if ($user->peran === 'superadmin') {
        return redirect()->route('superadmin.dashboard');
    } elseif ($user->peran === 'admin') {
        return redirect()->route('admin.dashboard');
    }
    
    return abort(403, 'Akses peran tidak sah.');
})->middleware(['auth'])->name('dashboard');

// =========================================================================

Route::middleware('guest')->group(function () {
    // Step 1 – Tampilkan form email lupa password
    Route::get('/auth/forgot-password', [OtpController::class, 'showForgotForm'])
         ->name('otp.forgot.form');

    // Step 2 – Proses kirim OTP ke email
    Route::post('/auth/forgot-password', [OtpController::class, 'sendOtp'])
         ->name('otp.send');

    // Step 3 – Tampilkan form verifikasi OTP
    Route::get('/auth/verifikasi-otp', [OtpController::class, 'showVerifyForm'])
         ->name('otp.verify.form');

    // Step 4 – Proses verifikasi kode OTP
    Route::post('/auth/verifikasi-otp', [OtpController::class, 'verifyOtp'])
         ->name('otp.verify');

    // Step 5 – Tampilkan form reset password baru
    Route::get('/auth/reset-password', [OtpController::class, 'showResetForm'])
         ->name('otp.reset.form');

    // Step 6 – Simpan password baru
    Route::post('/auth/reset-password', [OtpController::class, 'resetPassword'])
         ->name('otp.reset');

    // Bonus – Kirim ulang OTP
    Route::post('/auth/resend-otp', [OtpController::class, 'resendOtp'])
         ->name('otp.resend');
});

    <script>
        function updateFileName(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            if (input.files.length) {
                display.textContent = input.files[0].name;
                display.style.color = "#333"; 
            } else {
                display.textContent = "Masukkan foto profil...";
                display.style.color = "#b0b0b0";
            }
        }

    <script>
        function tandaiHapusHeader(idFoto) {
            if(confirm('Hapus gambar ini dari slider?')) {
                const wadah = document.getElementById('wadahInputHapusHeader');
                const inputHidden = document.createElement('input');
                inputHidden.type = 'hidden';
                inputHidden.name = 'hapus_header[]';
                inputHidden.value = idFoto;
                wadah.appendChild(inputHidden);
                document.getElementById('foto-lama-box-' + idFoto).remove();
            }
        }

        let tumpukanHeader = [];
        function updateHeaderPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('headerNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('headerPreviewContainer');
            if (input.files) {
                for (let file of input.files) { tumpukanHeader.push(file); }
                container.innerHTML = '';
                const dt = new DataTransfer();
                tumpukanHeader.forEach((file) => {
                    dt.items.add(file);
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function(e) {
                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.src = e.target.result;
                        img.style = 'width:120px; height:75px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:6px;';
                        container.appendChild(img);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });
                input.files = dt.files;
                display.textContent = tumpukanHeader.length + " file dipilih";
            }
        }
    </script>

<script>
    function showPopupLogout() {
        var el = document.getElementById('popup-logout');
        el.style.display = 'flex';
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function hidePopupLogout() {
        var el = document.getElementById('popup-logout');
        el.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    // Tutup saat klik overlay
    document.getElementById('popup-logout').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === this) hidePopupLogout();
    });
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        // 1. BANNER SLIDESHOW UTAMA
        const headerContainer = document.querySelector('.header-slideshow-container');
        if (headerContainer) {
            setInterval(() => {
                const slides = headerContainer.querySelectorAll('img:not([style*="display: none"]), .banner-error-fallback.active');
                if (slides.length > 1) {
                    let currentIndex = Array.from(slides).findIndex(el => el.classList.contains('active'));
                    if (currentIndex !== -1) {
                        slides[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                        slides[(currentIndex + 1) % slides.length].classList.add('active');
                    }
                }
            }, 7000);
        }

        // 2. AUTOMATIC SLIDESHOW MULTI-FOTO CARD PERSONEL (5 DETIK)
        // Berjalan dinamis menyapu semua container profile-card yang mempunyai class .slideshow-container
        const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container');
        containers.forEach(container => {
            const images = container.querySelectorAll('img');
            if (images.length > 1) {
                let currentIndex = 0;
                setInterval(() => {
                    images[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % images.length;
                    images[currentIndex].classList.add('active');
                }, 5000); // Berganti otomatis setiap 5 detik
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    <script>
        // FUNGSI BARU: Memasukkan ID foto ke input hidden dan menyembunyikannya dari UI
        function tandaiHapusFoto(idFoto) {
            if(confirm('Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus gambar ini dari berita?')) {
                const wadah = document.getElementById('wadahInputHapusFoto');
                
                // Buat elemen input hidden baru
                const inputHidden = document.createElement('input');
                inputHidden.type = 'hidden';
                inputHidden.name = 'hapus_foto[]';
                inputHidden.value = idFoto;
                wadah.appendChild(inputHidden);

                // Hilangkan box foto dari tampilan layar
                const boxFoto = document.getElementById('foto-lama-box-' + idFoto);
                if(boxFoto) {
                    boxFoto.remove();
                }
            }
        }

        // Penanganan Akumulasi Gambar Baru
        let kumpulanFileBerita = [];

        function updateFileNameAndPreview(input) {
            const display = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
            const container = document.getElementById('imagePreviewContainer');
            
            if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
                for (let i = 0; i < input.files.length; i++) {
                    kumpulanFileBerita.push(input.files[i]);
                }

                container.innerHTML = '';
                const dataTransferObat = new DataTransfer();
                
                kumpulanFileBerita.forEach((file) => {
                    dataTransferObat.items.add(file);

                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function(e) {
                        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                        wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
                        wrapper.style.display = 'inline-block';

                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.src = e.target.result;
                        img.style.width = '100px';
                        img.style.height = '100px';
                        img.style.objectFit = 'cover';
                        img.style.borderRadius = '6px';
                        img.style.border = '1px dashed #A87C7C';

                        wrapper.appendChild(img);
                        container.appendChild(wrapper);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });

                input.files = dataTransferObat.files;
                display.textContent = kumpulanFileBerita.length + " file baru dipilih (terakumulasi)";
                display.style.color = "#333";
            }
        }
    </script>

<script>
    function showPopupBatal() {

        el.style.display = 'flex';
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function hidePopupBatal() {

        if (e.target === this) hidePopupBatal();
    });

<script>
    function openFilterModal() { document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex'; }
    function closeFilterModal() { document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none'; }
    window.onclick = function(event) { if (event.target == document.getElementById('filterModal')) closeFilterModal(); }

    function syncCardVisual(checkboxElement) {
        let parentCard = checkboxElement.closest('.filter-checkbox-card');
        if (checkboxElement.checked) parentCard.classList.add('selected-box');
        else parentCard.classList.remove('selected-box');
    }

    function submitPublicForm() { document.getElementById('formPublicNews').submit(); }

    document.getElementById('searchPublicNews').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); submitPublicForm(); }
    });

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const headerContainer = document.querySelector('.header-slideshow-container');
        if (headerContainer) {
            setInterval(() => {
                const slides = headerContainer.querySelectorAll('img:not([style*="display: none"]), .banner-error-fallback.active');
                if (slides.length > 1) {
                    let currentIndex = Array.from(slides).findIndex(el => el.classList.contains('active'));
                    if (currentIndex !== -1) {
                        slides[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                        slides[(currentIndex + 1) % slides.length].classList.add('active');
                    }
                }
            }, 7000);
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-container').forEach(container => {
            setInterval(() => {
                const elements = container.querySelectorAll('img:not([style*="display: none"]), .inline-error-fallback.active');
                if (elements.length > 1) {
                    let currentIndex = Array.from(elements).findIndex(el => el.classList.contains('active'));
                    if (currentIndex !== -1) {
                        elements[currentIndex].classList.remove('active');
                        elements[(currentIndex + 1) % elements.length].classList.add('active');
                    }
                }
            }, 5000);
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    function openFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeFilterModal() {
        document.getElementById('filterModal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    window.onclick = function(event) {
        const modal = document.getElementById('filterModal');
        if (event.target == modal) {
            closeFilterModal();
        }
    }

    function syncCardVisual(checkboxElement) {
        let parentCard = checkboxElement.closest('.filter-checkbox-card');
        if (checkboxElement.checked) {
            parentCard.classList.add('selected-box');
        } else {
            parentCard.classList.remove('selected-box');
        }
    }

    function submitFormFilter() {
        document.getElementById('formFilterLog').submit();
    }

    document.getElementById('searchLog').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            submitFormFilter();
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function togglePw() {
        const inp  = document.getElementById('password');
        const icon = document.getElementById('eye-icon');
        const show = inp.type === 'password';
        inp.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
        icon.innerHTML = show
            ? '<path d="M17.94 17.94A10.07 10.07 0 0 1 12 20c-7 0-11-8-11-8a18.45 18.45 0 0 1 5.06-5.94M9.9 4.24A9.12 9.12 0 0 1 12 4c7 0 11 8 11 8a18.5 18.5 0 0 1-2.16 3.19m-6.72-1.07a3 3 0 1 1-4.24-4.24"/><line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"/>'
            : '<path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>';
    }
</script>
